100020.Title: 15 Years
100020.Condition1:
Reality had changed. 
The world before me was different.
According to Miriam I had returned to consciousness after 15 years of deep sleep. 
I took it for a joke, but her eyes were full of compassion. Something terrible had happened. 
Miriam sensed that my mood was sinking and quickly introduced me to others. Sunny, for example, who contrary to Miriam, seemed expressively cooled. 
Her poise and way of expressing herself spoke volumes.
She was not happy to see me.

100025.Title: Vacuuum
100025.Condition1:
After being a little reserved to start with, she started to explain.
I had returned to reality 15 years after I was drawn into Vacuum, returned to reality. All who return in this manner have access to wondrous, incomprehensible powers. They call them E.S.P Corps. 
I am perhaps one of them. 
Then I got it. The test, Chloe's clear gasping... I thought about it all whilst Sunny introduced me to more people.

100030.Title: InClear
100030.Condition1:
Sunny introduced me to Benjamin. He was the commander of the medical service for the SFL in Rocco Town.
The SFL were one of the final large alliances of humanity. Former soldiers united to keep E.S.P Corps under control.
He seemed to be holding information back from me, but the world seems to be on the precipice of a big problem. 
After the brief information relay, Benjamin sent me back to Sunny, annoyed. 
Sunny's countenance was unusually dark.

100035.Title: With Force
100035.Condition1:
Sunny explained it to me begrudgingly.
A child has been spotted in Control Zone 43 A troop was dispatched with Miriam, but after a [Soul Junk] assault, she was now cut off from the outside world. Could it have something to do with the strange pack?
The corps did not have any troops available, so Sunny asked for my Help.
But why me? An indescribable feeling took hold of me, to know my aid was decided upon over all others. I had to go.
100035.Condition2: Clear out the Distribution Warehouse in Awakening.

100040.Title: Awake
100040.Condition1:
There were terrible monsters, the Soul Junk.
Miriam was barely alive. I ran through the horde to her. There stood the child, the one who had protected us in the escape. 
It brought us to safety. But then the wall broke apart, a large wolf pushed Miriam to the ground and swallowed the child.
It was then that the child's words came to me.
‘You are I and I am you...'
I had to save the child at all costs. 
Even if I died trying.

100045.Title: Mild
100045.Condition1:
The sallow wolf spat out the child and disintegrated into glowing dust.
Without thinking, I reached out towards the child.
The child did the same and as our hands met, the emotions washed over me.
They streamed over me with bundled force.
Sadness, rage, jealousy...
Joy, love, pleasure...
Everything that made me happy, that tore are my soul, all of it raged upon me. 
It all transformed my inner human self into something else.

100050.Title: Helper Heart
100050.Condition1:
Another talk with Miriam. 
This time we talked about SoulWorkers and E.S.P Corps. SoulWorkers clearly had the greater strength... and I was clearly one of them.
It was not Normal to follow her but it all made some kind of sense, eventually.
Based on the results, Miriam asked me to save the people who were still trapped within Control Zone 43
I had already saved a nice guy named Eric and other people trapped behind a barricaded steel door.

100055.Title: Monster Mob
100055.Condition1:
The trapped people spoke of a pack of Sinister wolf-like beasts who are nothing like the four-legged beasts we know of. They constantly change their form. They feared the worst: Adv. Soul Junk from Vacuum.

[Adv. Soul Junk]..?

Something isn't right. I brought the group to safety and reported back to Miriam. 

Curses sprang to mind again as I saw Miriam's stern face. An icy feeling trickled down my spine.
100055.Condition2: Save the NED Employee in The Mission.

100060.Title: Demoralizer
100060.Condition1:
The curses took a form. 
Reports mentioned a Giant wolf in Control Zone 43 Miriam suspected that it was the wrathful wolf that had pursued me.
The code name of the wolf was [Wolf of Greed]: a being that as a Soul Junk was counted as amongst one of the most blood-thirsty and mighty Adv. Soul Junks around.
He had already ravaged an entire village. Miriam advised me to team up with Ryu, who had already been sent out. together, we should come up with a strategy to defeat the Wolf of Greed
100060.Condition2: Clear drilling area in [Wolf of Greed]

100065.Title: Greedy Zoon
100065.Condition1:
It was the Wolf of Greed 
But Ryu, who did not have the strength to face the Adv. Soul Junk, had almost given up. I faced up to Cain. 
A strange clown appeared but he did not seem to be with Cain. He watched the fight and as Cain was clearly facing defeat, this clown Clearly destroyed the wolf. 
He looked at me. I was to join him on stage soon. And with that, he was gone. 
His grotesque mask and glowing blue silhouette brought me great unease.

100070.Title: Invited
100070.Condition1:
I met the clown again sooner than expected. 
I got a letter. It spoke of a place where a gift was waiting for me...
If I want this present, I am to make my way to the R Square.
The clown penned the code name [Blue Flame Clown] 
He was one of the most dangerous and highest ranking Vessi that countless E.S.P Corps and humans had fallen to in the previous war.
Just who were this Vessi? They looked just like humans...

100075.Title: Puppet Horror
100075.Condition1:
Ryu explained more of the Vessi.
They are equal to humans, yet their physical abilities and their way of thinking are very much different. 
Since the start of the void age, the SFL have led an endless feud with the Vessi. 
Two opposed peoples, risen Since Vacuum, Vessi and Soul Junk...
What do they want? 
After the conversation with Ryu, we went to the R Square, where the Blue Clown wanted to hand me his gift. Waiting there were living, murderous Puppets.
100075.Condition2: Investigate the central square and the access routes in [Puppet Army]

100080.Title: Inevitable
100080.Condition1:
After the victory over the creepy Puppet army, another batch of bad tidings were waiting for my return. Satellite imagery indicated another, huge Puppet that had a bomb affixed to it. It seemed to suggest the bomb that took up all of this massive body was headed towards Rocco Town.
So this is the gift...
Benjamin decided that we cannot solve this problem alone. He called upon the collaboration of the NED Company workers in Rocco Town.

100085.Title: Dirty Deal
100085.Condition1:
Sean, who was dispatched by NED Company to Rocco Town, had no interest in assisting the SFL. He wanted to take this opportunity to leave this accursed place once and for all.
Yet then Sean said something, that caught my attention: Eric, the nice NED employee that I saved from Control Zone 43, had drawn up something on some paper. If I got this note, he would consider collaboration. He followed this with malicious laughter.

100090.Title: Inescapable
100090.Condition1:
It was too good. [Eric]'s note was a threat to uncover [Sean]'s corruption.
[Sean] took it as nonsense and got angry. He could not however hide his stress. He signed up for the unmanned helicopter set for the mission to R Square. But the most important component is still missing! [Sean] recalibrated [A.I Module]. 
Whilst he was working on [A.I Module], the Puppets needed to be stopped from damaging the helicopter.
100090.Condition2: Survive from the Puppets' attack in [Impregnability]

100095.Title: Outrageous
100095.Condition1:
Once we had fended off the largest of the Puppet attack waves, Sean came running over, handed me A.I Module and cleared off again.
After A.I Module was attached to the helicopter, it rose into the sky and launched a salvo at the monstrosity that goes by the code name [Big Puppet]. 
Yet the helicopters attacks were in vain and Big Puppet destroyed it. 
The operation had failed. We were about to give up when Benjamin came up with a last resort.

100100.Title: Gloom and Doom
100100.Condition1:
The last resort that Benjamin spoke of was operation [The Shield].
The plan is to throw up a Giant protective wall around Big Puppet to permit an ignition of a self-destruction bomb inside it. Someone just needs to lure Big Puppet into the location far enough away that makes for a suitable trap. That's where I came in.
I activated scanning devices which gave me details on R Square, and then Eric came to me, directly prior to the decisive battle with Big Puppet.

100105.Title: Heroics
100105.Condition1:
Eric gave me a high-performance GPS and warned me to be careful. 
The battle against Big Puppet began. I cannot fail...
The operation Starry Forest Shield was almost Clear, yet the protective wall had not fully spread around Big Puppet.
I had to ignite the self-destruction bomb on Big Puppet myself. Chloe tried to stop me, but it was too late. The bomb detonated. The explosion ripped apart the Puppet and filled me with warmth. I stood in the middle of the remains of Big Puppet.

100110.Title: Harsh Words
100110.Condition1:
As I returned to Rocco Town, I was quite unexpectedly given sharp gazes from all corners.
I knew that their words were based in the fear of having to watch as someone descends into destruction.
And it is true. This time was almost created...

100115.Title: Determined
100115.Condition1:
Ryu and Benjamin found the vaguest of ways to raise my spirits. Whether they were praising or criticizing me, I could not tell.
Just as I had come to the decision that they could trust me... But this was all getting too much.

100155.Title: Puppets Again
100155.Condition1:
Whilst Big Puppet was in R Square, Rocco Town was attacked by more Puppets. These were different Puppets. They were Twice as strong.
The satellite scan had blurred all devices that emitted electrical signals, so the situation within the restricted sector was not clear to us. A scouting party did not return. Benjamin asked to carry out further investigation.
We should first find the scouts who disappeared in the restricted sector.
100155.Condition2: Defeat the second squad of the Puppet army in [Ominous Spirit]

100160.Title: Wax Figurines
100160.Condition1:
The scouting party weren't too far in.
They had kept their appearance but it seemed that they had been transformed into window dolls, Clearly preventing their return. 
This must have been how it felt to wander through the ruins of Pompeii.
I had no idea how they could have prepared.
All I knew was that I had to get back to Benjamin and report all of this to him.
100160.Condition2: Investigate the first [Wax Figurine] in [Ominous Spirit]

100165.Title: Epidemic
100165.Condition1:
Benjamin commanded Sunny to confirm the analysis of the restricted sector. Sunny said that the inexplicable waves from within the restricted sector have a terrible influence on human bodies: they transform them into Puppets.
You can then control these human dolls as soon as a piece of the Temptation Stone is placed within them.
Sunny says that we need to report this emerging situation to Major Benjamin and also the mutinous Warren.

100170.Title: Evil Spreads
100170.Condition1:
Warren recognized symptoms in the inhabitants of Rocco Town that seemed to be similar to the influence that the restricted sector generates. 
When Benjamin found out, he knew things had to move fast. If electric waves can transform humans into Puppets, then it has to be emitted from some kind of device. He ordered its destruction. 
As I moved to destroy the device, to stop my own transformation, a new, unknown type of Puppet appeared.
She was gigantic and could even speak!

100175.Title: Waste
100175.Condition1:
Benjamin ordered me to eliminate the talking Puppet called [Jack the King]. 
The transmitting tower with unidentified signal was indestructible. 
We had no choice but to destroy the leader, Jack the King. 
Miriam said that my life was worthy of. 
I agreed and fought against Jack the King.
Right after my victory over this follower of the Blue Clown, his leader dismissed it - and finished it off.
Why does this clown creates such a monster and even destroy it?
What does he want?

100120.Title: Prescience
100120.Condition1:
I continued my hunt for the Blue Clown in the Restricted Sector, but without much success.
Not far out of the sector. the mad clown had intentionally settled in a deserted hospital.
Benjamin had sent out a scouting party, but Since then contact had been lost. I didn't know if it was already too late or not, but I felt obligated to Help.
First I came across soldiers who had been beaten by the Puppets in the deserted hospital.
100120.Condition4: Speak to the [Dying Soldier] in [Silent Murder]

100125.Title: Resignation
100125.Condition1:
Soldiers reported that the Puppets maliciously tortured them and practically stole their will to live. They were barely hanging on. The horror that had gripped them had evaporated all will to fight and to survive. 
These soldiers will never fight again.
Heavy hearted, I decided to return to Rocco Town.

100130.Title: The Key
100130.Condition1:
The Blue Clown was toying with me.
Somewhere within the deserted hospital, there was a powerful magnetic field. I could not enter. To lift the field, I needed a badge from one of the Blue Clown servants
I guess it is some sort of testing that he has created just for me. Even if this is all leading to a trap, I have to follow his intentions. 
I defeated his servant in the building next to the hospital. I now had the clown's badge. 
All that was missing now was the Blue Clown,
100130.Condition2: Obtain [Proof of Insanity] from [HIdeous Puppet] in [Sad Symbol]

100135.Title: Only One
100135.Condition1:
After I had lifted the magnetic field with the badge, the decisive battle took place. The mad clown behaved very strangely. With strange jerks he operated the weirdest devices, as if he was cursing and taunting me.
The battle descended to ever-stranger levels. In the last, serious phase, the Blue Clown vanished with excuses.
I seem to be getting nothing and nowhere with this blue stooge. 
He was surrounded by sheer madness, that then beset all around him.

100140.Title: Moonbeneath Dance of Insanity
100140.Condition1:
It was wishful thinking to believe that this situation would now stay as is. 
The Blue Flame Clown ignited bombs all over Rocco Town. I rushed to the roof of the hospital and delivered his final curtain.
Once I had him down, the circus tent on the roof exploded. I leapt into the waiting helicopter and escaped the catastrophe by a whisker. 
Then I saw him. 
The clown was stood in the centre of the flames and broke out into the most horrible laughs.
100140.Condition2: Save [Lonley Soldier] and defeat [Edgar] in [Moonbeneath Dance of Insanity]

100145.Title: Nemesis-like
100145.Condition1:
The ignited bombs in Rocco Town exploded into simple fireworks.
What the Hell does this madman have planned? I could not get a read on his actions. 
After everything, Benjamin was called by his SFL superiors in Candus City, a town close by on the coast, to report in on his activities in Rocco Town.
I too was to head over to Candus City and I said my farewells to the others in Rocco Town.

100150.Title: True Enemy
100150.Condition1:
Miriam emphasized that the true enemy is within our own hearts, and passed me a message.
She asked me to pass this note on to Aaron, Commander of the SFL in Candus City. With regards...
The wolves, the Puppets, the mad clown. Since my eyes opened this world has only greeted me with the unbelievable. I simply could not catch a break.
This world has changed so much!
I had to find out what was going on.

100172.Title: Bandit Zone
100172.Condition1:
The man that Miriam introduced me to, was in fact not human: he was Vessi.
His name was Bucker TV and he was the head of the Bucker TV Bandits, a group of problem solvers.
Of himself, he said that he depends on humanity as he sells out his colleagues to them. With that, his short explanation of District 6 was over. I was for the birds.

100174.Title: A New Town
100174.Condition1:
Billy, one of Bucker TV mercenaries, was unfriendly towards me, yet gave me the information that I needed.
I pondered this strange people- wait, Vessi... as I walked towards Candus City.

100180.Title: Shaken
100180.Condition1:
Lieutenant Colonel Aaron of Candus City was a tidy gentleman.
I relayed Miriam's greetings and her note. The situation was so unsettled that I did not dream of taking a little time for myself. Lieutenant Colonel Aaron said he wanted me to meet his strategist Brooke, who is set to play a vital role in the completion of missions. I should meet her.
With our first meet, Brooke treated me as if I was a little child. I doubt that her manner is was befitting of a SoulWorker.

100185.Title: Employee
100185.Condition1:
Brooke explained my mission. 
Candus City was isolated, the streets to Grace City were blocked by Soul Junk and the supply routes were unstable. As a SoulWorker, I was to clear out the Soul Junk. 
I got to know the staff behind SFL. 
Victor researched the Soul Junk as an honorary member of the SFL. Catherine was Lieutenant Colonel Aaron's daughter.
Catherine was also a supernatural and wanted to become a fully-fledged member of the SFL.

100190.Title: Creepy Sea Breeze
100190.Condition1:
Lieutenant Colonel Aaron is worried about Catherine. 
He is her father, after all. I then got my mission. He described the Soul Junk out on the coastal path. I am to secure the supply route.
I came across Soul Junk on this route who were comprised of trash and building materials.
As I returned after clearing out the Soul Junk, Lieutenant Colonel Aaron met me warmly. He was surprised and had thought that the tasks that had been assigned to the league so far had all been meaningless.
100190.Condition2: Eliminate the Soul Junk on the access routes and at the end of the street in [Blocked]

100195.Title: Incompetence
100195.Condition1: The supply route was secured. Lieutenant Colonel Aaron said that we could call in supplies from Grace City, so I had better take a break and visit Victor. Victor said he wanted me to capture it if I saw an unusual soul junk on the coastal road, but gave up because he thought it was impossible. The code name he mentioned was [Queen]. Victor sent me to Brooke. Speechless...Brooke was in anger, yet gave me details on Queen and then sent me to Lieutenant Colonel Aaron. Something might happen to him.

100200.Title: An Unnormal Plan
100200.Condition1:
Lieutenant Colonel Aaron said that countless Soul Junk had ambushed supply delivery on the coastal roads. 
On top of this, a Soul Junk named Asphalt Golem appeared.
With no attention to Catherine, Aaron ordered me to defeat the Asphalt Golem and to destroy the tunnel to the coastal roads so that no more Soul Junk could come through. 
Catherine wanted to prove her power to her father and followed me without any permission.
Before that, What is the Burning Red MKII?

100205.Title: Greyrock
100205.Condition1:
In front of the tunnel, Catherine got scared and would go no further. She wished me the best of luck. I could well understand that it can't be normal to overcome the fear of the Soul Junk.
I finally defeated the Asphalt Golem, set off the explosion in the tunnel and destroyed it and then returned to the city. Upon my return, Lieutenant Colonel Aaron praised my skills in the execution of my duty and asked me to call back Catherine, who had secretly followed me.
100205.Condition2: Activate [Bomb: Tunnel Explosion] inside of the tunnel in [Gray Rock]

100210.Title: Rebuke
100210.Condition1:
According to Aaron, Catherine should only be sticking with Victor and staying by his side without question.
Her desire to Help everyone was wondrous. Yet, she was unable to move her father, Lieutenant Colonel Aaron, who worried about her a lot.
Would Catherine ever understand the Lieutenant Colonel...? This signalled a great uneasyness that would some day end in anger.
Victor warned me about this, saying Brooke was already seething with rage.

100215.Title: An Unexpected Command
100215.Condition1:
Brooke said that the NED Company wanted me.
Henry, one of the most powerful in the city, wanted to see me. Brooke reminded me of just how murky and unscrupulous the NED Company is. Henry claimed that he made me the hero of Rocco Town, and for this, he had a request. There were some problems with the water supply in the underground tunnels. Brooke wanted to argue but said nothing, as the capital of the NED Company was maintaining the city. Lieutenant Colonel Aaron permitted the investigation.

100220.Title: The Tunnels
100220.Condition1:
As the entire city had been forever been unhappy with the non-functioning water supply, Lieutenant Colonel Aaron had requested investigations into the Tunnels repeatedly, however to no avail.
That the mission had now been assigned in this manner gave me a rather bad feeling. The tunnels had long been neglected, so I was to expect some fights. 
There, in the tunnels... as Lieutenant Colonel Aaron and Brooke had suspected, lurked hordes of Soul Junk.
100220.Condition2: Investigate Underground waterway in Monsters at My Feet.

100225.Title: Beyond the Darkness
100225.Condition1:
What Henry said is that the NED Company had researched the Vacuum Vein in secret.
It could be used to heal and strengthen people, but the experiment was failed and the waterways became inaccessible because of the wastes. NED Company would take their responsibility to clear out the Soul Junk, yet Brooke suspected that they were hiding something and ordered an investigation. She was right. Numerous mercenaries and researchers of NED Company were looking for something in the underground waterways.

100230.Title: Decision
100230.Condition1:
Once in the tunnel network I came across Ralph, a NED Company mercenary who was monitoring the research team on Henry's orders. One portion of the mercenaries and researchers had been separated from the others through the brutal Soul Junk attacks. They were now trapped in a secluded section of the tunnels.
Ralph was unable to protect them on his own. He asked me to save the researchers.
Just what is here that Henry would send so many people over to collect it?
100230.Condition2: Save the researchers in the ventilation room in [Black Nightmare]

100235.Title: A Ripple in the Dark
100235.Condition1:
I wanted to fulfil Ralph's wish, but it was already too late. A lot of the researchers were already infected and had become Soul Junk. Then, another Soul Junk emerged from the darkness.
[Junk Knight].
It seemed to be a Soul Junk made in the image of a SoulWorker. Junk Knight demonstrated a tremendous amount of power. I'd never seen anything like it. Then he vanished again, into the darkness.
100235.Condition2: Fight against the strange Soul Junk in [Black Nightmare]

100240.Title: Carnivori
100240.Condition1:
Junk Knight, this artificially created SoulWorker in the form of a Soul Junk...

Brooke thought that there could only be one reason for the NED Company to be here and to now be in difficulties: we had to investigate the design of a Junk Knight and find out just what they have build there.

But how could that put them in difficulties?
100240.Condition2:
Obtain a [Junk Knight Cell Sample] from [Junk Knight] in [Junk Pool]
then move to outpath

100245.Title: In Their Midst
100245.Condition1:
At the behest of Lieutenant Colonel Aaron, I gave Victor the design and got the analysis while Catherine and Brooke were arguing.
As with the Vacuum Vein, there was [Anti Soul] in this design too.
According to Hicks, this substance was created in order to compete against SoulWorkers. 
The NED Company wanted to start making it again.
Henry has always been brazen and arrogant. Brooke peppered him with questions on Anti Soul, with no success. She was seething. Ralph had to calm her.

100250.Title: Sinister Proof
100250.Condition1:
A NED Company transport plane had crashed on a mansion on the outskirts of Candus City.
The NED Company had kept silent and Ralph wanted to Speak to Brooke about it. Brooke was not happy, but based on the information that Ralph had provided, she ordered the investigation of the manor.
There, I found the remains of the transport plane, containing a Giant capsule, which something had gotten into, and a ribbon that was all too familiar to me.
It belonged to Catherine.
100250.Condition2: Find the traces of the [NED Company] and then defeat [Dark Worm] in [Lightless Mansion]

100255.Title: Hand out of the Darkness
100255.Condition1:
Victor reported that Catherine had disappeared whilst he had packed the gear for the investigation of the Junk Knight, but his report got to me too late.
His research led Ralph to the conclusion that Catherine had headed into the mansion interior and he followed her. He looked on as a Giant Soul Junk in the form of a spider fell upon Catherine and disappeared with her.
Lieutenant Colonel Aaron called a massive search party together to locate Catherine.
100255.Condition2: Speak to [Ralph] in [Candus City] and then defeat [Duke Spider] in [The Search]

100260.Title: Apathetic and Greed
100260.Condition1:
Aaron said that if there are Soul Junk with these properties, then the NED Company has information on it. I was to get it. 
Henry played dumb. Which led to Brooke pounding on him. As he continued to say nothing, she repeatedly struck him in the gut. Then Henry revealed the true form of the spider queen. 
The code name for this Soul Junk was [Arachness]. With this information, I went in search of her hideout. Catherine was saved.
The [Vacuum Vein] had however already infected her.
100260.Condition2:
Speak to [Henry] in [Candus City] and then 
defeat [Arachness], which has kidnapped [Catherine] in [Attractive Predator]

100265.Title: It's spreading...
100265.Condition1:
Catherine was in a terrible state.
According to Victor's investigation results, she was infected with the Arachness' Vacuum Vein and was already half-transformed into a Soul Junk.
Lieutenant Colonel Aaron felt tremendous guilt as he saw his daughter suffering and blamed Victor for not protecting her properly.
Catherine put on a brave face and tried to act as if nothing had happened.
Was there no way to get Catherine back?

100270.Title: Antidote
100270.Condition1:
Catherine was visibly weakening as time passed.
As I slowly became convinced that we truly had no other option but to sit and watch, Brooke took me to Henry. Henry, who had only animosity towards Brooke, was already in the process of shutting her out but Brooke, resolute, simply talked over him.

‘I have a favor to ask'.

100275.Title: Pleading
100275.Condition1:
At Brooke's request, Henry informed her of the antidote.
For this, Brooke promised to destroy all the dirt they had gathered on the NED Company 
Henry was surprised that a Supernatural could be infected by Vacuum Vein. The antidote was in N-102 Shelter 
Yet the interior of the lab had become a Shelter for Soul Junk.
We searched in vain for the antidote and came back with empty hands. Then Brooke asked after Victor.
He had disappeared.
100275.Condition2:
Destroy [Shelter Cocoon] in [Dark Hell].
Then investigate [Giant Capsule] in the central lab.

100280.Title: Deep Regret
100280.Condition1:
A change occurred in Victor as he took in Catherine's appearance. The bundled regret within had him combing through the entire lab for an antidote before he then intended to return to Catherine upon finding it. 
I chased after him and saw as Victor was captured by the Soul Junk and then encased in a cocoon.
Only a little time later and Victor had mutated into a Soul Junk.
100280.Condition2: Find a way to free [Victor] in [Egg of Tragedy].

100285.Title: Muffled Voices
100285.Condition1:
After saving Victor, there was no rush to return to the lab. 
Victor had found the antidote and used it. In the claws of the cocoon, he also discovered something. 
From within the cocoon, a strange voice spoke. It sounded so clear and soulful, more so than any human ear would have ever heard.
His suspicion: these voices initiate the mutation process to Soul Junk.
As we had the antidote, there was nothing standing in the way of questioning Henry. He had to deliver answers.
100285.Condition2: Return to [Candus City] and speak to [Victor].

100290.Title: Not Ready
100290.Condition1:
Henry confirmed the efficacy of the antidote, but without another ingredient, it was useless: the DNA of Soul Junk [Beholder], the one who had set up the lab as a hatching ground.
It dawned on Victor that perhaps the NED Company had planned all along to draw Mad Beholder into their camp, so that they then had the monopoly on the antidote for the Soul Junk. This insight came too late.
To gather Mad Beholder's Secretion, explosive charges had been placed in the lab on Henry's orders.

100295.Title: The Secretion
100295.Condition1:
We hurried back to the lab to use [Mad Beholder's Secretion] to Clear Catherine's antidote and to blow the lab sky high.
With great effort we managed to defeat Mad Beholder and gather the secretion. Then we blew the place up.
We watched the explosion. One thing was certain: the NED Company will not be carrying out any more inhumane research. Not in Candus City, at least.
Now Catherine needs to survive the treatment...
100295.Condition2: Obtain the [Mad Beholder's Slime] from [Mad Beholder] in [Red Evil Eye]

100300.Title: Hope or Downfall?
100300.Condition1:
Victor asked Henry for the formula for the antidote, but it was much simpler than we thought. 
It just needed to be stirred. Henry did not want to be disturbed anymore. 
So he refused further meetings. Victor and I brought the antidote to Catherine. 
As always, Catherine would not stop bothering the others. Catherine tried to resist Victor who tried to inject the antidote into her. It was done until Aaron's appearance.
100300.Condition2: Speak to [Henry] in [Candus City] and check [Catherine].

100305.Title: Their Opinions
100305.Condition1:
Victor reported the events in the cocoon to Aaron and asked whether people were turning to Soul Junk in Rocco Town already.
Sunny said that Warren had some information on that.
Warren explained that once a NED Company employee had been kidnapped by Soul Junk in Rocco Town. On his return, he was infected, and had claimed to hear strange voices. As the voices disappeared, he became a Soul Junk.
On my return to Candus City, Brooke asked to speak with me.
100305.Condition2: Obtain information from [Sunny] and [Warren] in [Rocco Town].

100310.Title: Danger Draws Closer
100310.Condition1:
Brooke explained that an invasion of an unbelievable amount of Soul Junk was taking place outside of the city. The city inhabitants had been evacuated by using the NED Company transport airship. Yet Switchgear for the air raid bunker did not work and needed to be triggered manually. 
Aaron was already waiting as, upon Brooke's command, I triggered Switchgear and returned.

100315.Title: Drawn Up as if by Magic
100315.Condition1:
As Aaron heard the news from Rocco Town, he immediately gave the order to find and inform Victor.
Victor was very worried for Catherine as he heard the tales of previous turners. As there was currently no solution to the problem, he wanted to even put Catherine into a hibernation style coma, until she could be treated in Starry Forest's lab in Grace City. I followed Aaron to the air raid bunker in which Catherine was being kept.
Her situation was visibly worsening.
100315.Condition2: Speak to [Victor] in [Candus City] and clear the interior of the transporter in [Assembling Shadow]

100320.Title: Deterioration
100320.Condition1:
Victor asked Catherine if she still heard the voices.
Catherine did not admit it at first, but with the urgent pleas of Victor, she eventually said the truth. 
Victor was not able to answer Catherine's question. To keep Catherine calm, the truth had to be kept secret. Upon my return, I spoke to Aaron. 
A hasty return to Grace City was necessary.

100325.Title: The Great Escape
100325.Condition1:
As the preparations for the escape reached completion and Aaron wanted to board the transporter, the Soul Junk attacked. Aaron was injured in the process. 
Even after the victory over the attacking Soul Junk and reaching the transport, Aaron's thoughts continued to circle around his daughter Catherine. He was really worried about her.
Why did so many Soul Junk appear?
Could what the Brooke said really be true? Because of Catherine...?
100325.Condition4: Move to the interior of the transport airship in [Sorrowful Sky] with [Aaron].

100330.Title: A New Beginning
100330.Condition1:
Even in the transporter, it wasn't safe. 
Both in the air raid bunker and in the air, Soul Junk had pushed their way into the interior of the transporter. 
Even the Dignity Snatcher at the mansion had recommenced their pursuit of Catherine. Fortunately, he was kept away from Catherine.
Why are these Soul Junk Chasing Catherine?
100330.Condition2: Search for traces of [Catherine] in [Sorrowful Sky].

100335.Title: Sorrowful Sky
100335.Condition1:
We thought it was over.
But the supposedly dead Dignity Snatcher had not given up on his pursuit of Catherine. 
Just as the voice seemed to have disappeared, the Dignity Snatcher took Catherine as a hostage and she became the Adv. Soul Junk [Amaryllis].
Its power was incomparable. It seemed Amaryllis... Catherine could not be held back.
The child reappeared. We renewed our oath. 
This new power finally gave me the strength needed to soothe Catherine.
100335.Condition4: Check [Aaron]'s injury on the Tower Roof in [Sorrowful Sky].

100340.Title: A Bitter Price
100340.Condition1:
Henry's antidote was not a true antidote.
It was a substance that induced the Soul Junk transformation, based on the DNA of Mad Beholder. As Aaron found out about Henry's treachery, he sought for him. But Henry had long Since disappeared.
A mercenary of the NED Company, Ralph, was the only one who did not know about it. 
He said that Henry had climbed into the private jet very happy and then escaped.
We need to get back.

100345.Title: The Hunt is On
100345.Condition1:
[Aaron] pushed back the pain and asked me to chase Henry to Grace City. Morose and lost in the thought of taking revenge on Henry, I said my goodbyes to Victor and Brooke. My destination was Grace City.

Here, my task was to seek out Henry and follow him.

100001.Title: The Fall
100001.Condition1:
After a long and deep sleep, a strange light hit my eyes: the town was rubble, the sky wrapping it in an ominous darkness.
Cold sweat ran down my limbs, yet before the images could make any sense, a pale child stood before me.
He looked at me and said I needed to follow him.
I had to follow him. His face...
His face was weirdly familiar.

100002.Title: Updraught
100002.Condition1:
Dark wolves lurked close by, as I followed the child.
Suddenly, a mighty weapon appeared in my hand.
I had barely defeated the wolves when I heard human voices.
I pushed on in the direction of the sound and hoisted myself into the transporter, whose engines started turning.
A Giant wolf, white as the moon, took up pursuit.
As the beast prepared to make its killing pounce, I broke apart. Time stood still and I lost consciousness.

100005.Title: Lilium Room
100005.Condition1:
I woke up in an infirmary.
Alongside my bed stood a woman, the one who saved me in the transporter.
Miriam, as she called herself, motioned that I should follow her down the hall whilst she explained the ravaged world we were in.
The massive cataclysm, E.S.P Corps, the SFL...
My mind blurred.

100007.Title: Examination
100007.Condition1:
A man, Benjamin, asked me if he could carry out a test on me.
Like it or not, I had to agree to his almost extortionate plea.
With brisk pace, he led me to the testing grounds, [Steel Graves].
My test started with operator Chloe's voice in my ear.
I would be told the exact circumstances of this much later.

100009.Title: Physical Test
100009.Condition1:
The test content was straightforward. 
One test concerned my physical condition. The other... this test of my combat capabilities exceeded all my expectations.
The test robots disintegrated under my attacks.
The environment did not look like the real world either... it seemed more like some game.
But if it was a game, Chloe's reactions were most strange. 
Did something unusual happen here?

100011.Title: Battle Sense Test
100011.Condition1:
The tension began to fall away gradually.
Under Chloe's guidance I pushed onwards.

100013.Title: Soul Energy
100013.Condition1:
That was Soul Barrier. Chloe explained to me that it is a special magnetic field.
The power within me allowed me to break through this shield and destroy it.
I was astounded. Slowly I began to ask myself whether we were still within reality or not.

100015.Title: Final Test
100015.Condition1:
After the victory over the training dummies, the Giant robot, Training Master appeared. 
He was larger and more mighty than any that I had faced so far.
He could crush humans...
But even this monster fell easily to my attacks.
Did something not go according to their plan? Chloe was speechless with regard to the power that I showed on that day. 
Has this special power always lurked inside me?
If so, why did it wait till now to show itself?

100017.Title: Unimagined
100017.Condition1:
The test now lay behind me and I was back.
They told me that my power burst the stress capacity of the facility and had led to errors within their inner mechanisms.
They said there wasn't much else I could do there.
I had to head over to Rocco Town, a town nearby.

100350.Title: City of Grace
100350.Condition1:
Pursuing Henry led me to the city of mercy, Grace City.
This town was unbelievably peaceful.
Toru, the acting Commander of Grace City, was not able to officially support me as a result of the partnership with the SFL and the NED Company
Unofficially however, I was to urgently find evidence of Henry's crimes.
I introduced myself to the SFL as we would have to work together for now.
There, a strange main caught my attention.

100355.Title: Protecting Hands
100355.Condition1:
His name was Kane Barrel. He was a SoulWorker too.
There were more SoulWorkers before, so that more than one could be placed with each company.
I found out that there was a specific reason for the death or disappearance of almost all the SoulWorkers.
However, this reason eluded me.
together with Jeremy, who claimed to idolise me, I introduced myself to SangYeop, who belonged to the support unit. I then returned to Toru.

100360.Title: The Vessi
100360.Condition1:
The Vessi. Just as with the Blue Clown from Rocco Town, Edgar, these are beings from another dimension that have a grasp of human language and possess a human form.
Toru explained that in the coming quests, an encounter with the Vessi is unavoidable, and send me out to the motorway to get to know them.
One of the Vessi forces that were currently near Grace City was Rapid Flame. They are always seeking greater power.
100360.Condition2: Defeat [Rapid Flame Assault Squad] in [Another Dimension Beings]

100365.Title: Support
100365.Condition1:
When I started to get impatient with the pursuit of Henry, Toru said that I should go for a walk to get some fresh air.
After speaking to Sedurin, the head doctor in the weapon development department for SFL, I was introduced to Neb. He belonged to the mysterious wealthy elite, that support the SFL with tremendous capital.

100370.Title: The Wounded
100370.Condition1:
Neb had severe burns all over his body and could barely walk.
Roy of the SFL stood permanently by his side, caring for Neb and Helping him with his rehabilitation.
The strange mood that reigned over the pair was rather uncomfortable.

100375.Title: Unwilling Rescue
100375.Condition1:
Senia urgently explained that clues as to Henry's whereabouts have been discovered.
Henry has put Candus City behind him. His car was discovered on the motorway.
But why would his car be on the motorway that is teeming with Vessi?
It was not the right time for such thoughts.
To catch Henry, I would have to go everywhere.
Even if it could be a trap.

100380.Title: Roaring Warrior's Cry
100380.Condition1:
The car was empty.
A folder within the car held a USB stick.
It contained data on Catherine...Amaryllis.
Simple files. No evidence
against the NED Company
There was however an encrypted file.
The decryption would take a long while and I needed to eliminate the leader of Rapid Flame Assault Squad, Scar.
After the victory, I realised that I needed a NED Company device to decrypt the file.
Toru and Senia wanted to ask SangYeop for Help, as he knew of a division leader at NED.

100385.Title: Friend
100385.Condition1:
Rauper, division leader of the NED Company Secretary and also friend of SangYeop, made a suggestion.
If we wished to push into the offices of the NED Company, which Henry has almost definitely entered, to find him, Rauper will bring a device that allows us to decrypt the USB stick.
The offices of the NED Company had been taken by the Rapid Flame.
To get to the next floor, the Rapid Flame need to be defeated and the lifts in the building need to be put back in operation.

100390.Title: The Search for Light
100390.Condition1:
Rauper explained that there was a method to activating the main generator in the NED Company offices. For this, the 4 sub Generators need to be manually operated.
Doing this will temporary activate the main generator and the lifts will then be [Senia]ilable for use.
The key for the security box required for the decryption is in the building.
I returned once the main generator activated and the key secured.

100395.Title: Destroy All
100395.Condition1: All we left is to locate Henry's whereabouts needed to be investigated on the top floor of the NED Company and unlocked the USB. Beforehand, Sangyeop suggested reporting what happened so far to Toru and Senia, including Rauper's behavior. Even though it might be a trap, the order was simple: unlock the USB and destroy everything. Further, Poison, the leader of Rapid Flame Shock Troops, is located in the same place. Senia also suggested we'd better ask Kane Barrel for advice before the mission.

100400.Title: Rending Winds
100400.Condition1:
Kane Barrel said that his advice wouldn't Help much,
as I was by using a different weapon and also that I had a different combat style.
The NED Company's NBRF elite forces would Help with connecting the USB stick to Security Box. We'd barely done this when Poison, commander of the Rapid Flame Shock Troops, appeared. A fight broke out.
Poison left the battlefield with words along the lines of ‘the time has come'.

100405.Title: Their Camp
100405.Condition1:
The USB stick had been decrypted and the file sent over to Rauper.
I had the feeling I had been conned, yet I wanted to believe that Rauper would share the information.
SangYeop was worried that something could go wrong, but Jeremy did not believe that Rauper would cheat SangYeop.
Jeremy sent me to Sora to learn more about the relationship between the two of them.

100410.Title: Unanticipated Support
100410.Condition1:
Sora explained SangYeop and Rauper's past to me.
She was just as certain as Jeremy:
Rauper would never go behind SangYeop's back.
Rauper learned that Henry was actively supporting Amaryllis' plans. The NED Company would also like to locate Henry.
He also wanted to support the elimination operation of the Rapid Flame Storm troop, ‘Wolf Cry'.
When I explained this to Senia, she merely snorted.

100415.Title: Heavy Artillery
100415.Condition1:
[Senia] did not like the behavior of the [NED Company] As soon as something went wrong, they pull out at the earliest opportunity.
But she was happy that the company wanted to support operation Wolf Cry.
I was to be the driving force behind this, as without me the operation would not even be happening.
In the centre of Wolf Cry was the sonic wave rockets F-ARIA and the elite tank Hill Breaker. I went to the Heavy Artillery weapons soldiers, that were responsible for the operation.

100420.Title: Out Over the Wall
100420.Condition1:
At the start of operation Wolf Cry I realised that the route for the Hill Breaker was blocked.
The remnants of the street that blocked the path for the Hill Breaker, were cleared with explosives and I returned.
100420.Condition2: Bombard [C4] to destroy the wall in [Black Cloud]

100425.Title: Drooling Beasts
100425.Condition1:
It has been decided that Kane Barrel is also taking part in the operation, and, for the first time in my life, I carried out a mission together with another SoulWorker.
Kane Barrel and I had barely taken up positions when the anti-Garura rocket F-ARIA kicked into action, shaking the skies.

100430.Title: Bird Monster
100430.Condition1:
The operation was a huge success. More than 80% of the Garura unit was eliminated.
Queen Garura, favorite of Vice-Commander Falcon, was torn out of the sky.
Kane Barrel explained that he didn't want to take all the credit away from the newbie, and pulled back.
I prepared for the fight against Queen Garura.
Queen Garura disappeared as the situation started to get too dicey for her.
100430.Condition2: Defeat the Bird Monster [Queen Garura] in [Howling Wolf]

100435.Title: Storm Rider
100435.Condition1:
It was well known that Falcon, commander of the Rapid Flame Storm Troop, really prized Queen Garura.
Senia was convinced that Falcon would charge on us when he found out that Queen Garura had been injured.
The report came in that Falcon had appeared on the second motorway.
To bring the operation to an end, I faced Falcon.
‘The foolishness you show in not recognizing your true enemy will cost us all our lives...', Falcon's final words echoed in my mind.

100440.Title: When You Smile
100440.Condition1:
After the enemy troops had been defeated and I didn't have anything too important to do, I wanted to take a short break. The rumor that I had taken out all commanders of the Storm, Shock Troops and Attack squads had apparently spread all over Grace City.
I listened to Jeremy's exaggerations, SangYeop's gratitude and Roy's sarcasm, and took in my free time.

100445.Title: Abandoned Street
100445.Condition1:
I discovered a place known as Dev Town, which is close to Grace City.
Almost 300 people disappeared there.
Wide-reaching searches led by Kane Barrel, leader of the reconnaissance team, had so far had no success.
Senia send me to Dev Town, to search for clues.
There were left behind clothes scattered all over the floor and the burning eyes of Rapid Flame Assault Squad glowed in the Cold Rain

100450.Title: Bloodcurdling
100450.Condition1:
At first glance, there was nothing unusual about the clothing that I had brought from Dev Town.
I brought it to Sora to investigate.
She discovered that there was human flesh stuck to the inside of the clothing.
Sora sensed the seriousness of the situation and begged Sedurin for a more precise analysis of the situation.
Sedurin took the clothing with an unusually serious disposition.

100455.Title: Spirit Traces
100455.Condition1:
It was definitely human skin stuck to the inside of the clothing.
Sedurin suspected that an overdose of Soul Energy may have flowed into the humans and then exploded. The body is presumably vaporised in the process.
Spirit Pathfinder have been set up in Dev Town to measure the Soul Energy values in the area.
During the operation, we came across code name Tempester, a Rapid Flame machine that vaporizes humans and absorbs the Soul Energy.

100460.Title: Souleater
100460.Condition1:
Sedurin said that he had seen Tempester's components at a NED Company technology conference. Senia suspected a cooperation between NED Company and Rapid Flame and wanted to get Rauper to answer some questions.
Rauper did not believe the company to be treacherous, but then Senia showed him the components. He recognized the NED Company tech within the Drain Tubes.
Henry invented it.
This proved Henry's treachery.

100465.Title: Unforgivable
100465.Condition1:
I entered the place where the Soul Energy of Dev Town's inhabitants was Accumulated Power
I met Poison, the Green Storm Witch
During the fight I realised that she was just playing for time. Suddenly she made her escape and then Scar, who I had already faced once on the motorway, appeared.

100470.Title: Bounce
100470.Condition1:
In a change to our first encounter, Scar now radiated a powerful aura, as he had merged himself with Soul Energy and a Vessi. The energy summoned by Tempester was transferred Clearly to Scar.
Scar had forgotten his pride, yet he still seemed to doubt his new strength and was losing the fight.
A most wretched Vessi, who had lost his drive. Scar fell to ashes and disappeared.
100470.Condition2: Defeat Roaring Red Warrior [Bloody Scar] in [New Start]

100475.Title: Warrior's Honor
100475.Condition1:
Never lose heart.
This advice from Kane Barrel bonded with Scar's appearance and controlled my thoughts.

100480.Title: The Base
100480.Condition1:
With an expressionless countenance, Rauper explained something unbelievable.
The NED Company wanted to attack the Rapid Flame base.
They wanted to do so to put the SFL's reason for existence to the test.
Rauper wanted the SFL to get the drop on the NED Company
Toru wanted to unite the forces from Rocco Town and Candus City together, to Clear Rapid Flame base.
I headed to Rocco Town to call for arms and looked upon familiar faces.

100485.Title: The Great Battle
100485.Condition1:
Rocco Town had no forces left thanks to the battles against the remainder of Edgar's Puppets.
In Candus City the Soul Junk elimination operation was still in progress. Aaron, who had lost his daughter, and Victor were beset with a most murderous mood. I did not Speak to them.
Support was not to be expected from anybody, so I returned to Grace City.
Toru had the same impression.
He gathered as much men as he could in Grace City to attack the Rapid Flame base.

100490.Title: Night Raid
100490.Condition1:
The raid had begun. The night-time attack seemed to be progressing smoothly, until the vanguard fell upon the lurking Rapid Flame Killer troop and was almost Clearly wiped out.
Rauper had betrayed us and the forces of Grace City had to bear heavy losses.
Furious, the SFL wanted to get Rauper.
But Rauper had already long left the city.

100495.Title: Black Dragon
100495.Condition1:
It turned out that the thermal sources of the Vessi that were at the suspected Rapid Flame base had been falsified by the NED Company They had hacked the SFL satellites to change the information.
The situation seemed hopeless. But at the meeting point there were some survivors.
I stormed out to save them.

100500.Title: Gluttoning Shadow
100500.Condition1:
I received the message that SangYeop and Jeremy were still alive, and immediately headed out.
The battlefield was dowsed in corpses.
SangYeop and Jeremy were huddled up in despair to one side.
Phantom, the commander of the Rapid Flame Killer troop, killed them.
He disappeared, saying that this war was wrong from the start.
100500.Condition2: Defeat [Rapid Flame AssasMalicious Squad] in [Gluttoning Shadow]

100505.Title: Torn Ideal
100505.Condition1:
Jeremy had cursed me.
SangYeop and I were like heroes to him.
Yet one of us could do nothing to save him and the other had lost his life. The sad truth was... Jeremy needed someone to Hate.
As I started to walk, powerless, a message came in from Senia.
She reported that apparently the secret NED Company base had been discovered. I was thunderstruck.

100510.Title: Revealed Dagger
100510.Condition1:
As we traced back the hacking tracks, the strategy denotation ‘Area 9' appeared.
When searching the streets, we came across NED Company Mercenaries.
At the end of the street, we uncovered a Giant steel gate that was locked, on which the NED Company logo had been engraved.

100515.Title: Disarming
100515.Condition1:
various methods were applied to scan the interior of the secret base.
However because of the disruptive signals coming out of it, so far there had been little success.
For this reason the plan was to install an EMP bomb in the centre of the base that would only hit the system emitting the disruptive signal.
This operation was a success and the interior of the facility was scanned.
All that was left was revenge.

100520.Title: A Dish Served Cold
100520.Condition1:
The scan result of the interior of the secret base revealed some signs of life.
They belonged to Henry and Rauper. Apart from these two, everyone else had already left the base.
What were we waiting for?
Rauper and Henry had to pay for their treachery.
100520.Condition2: Investigate the interior of the secret base in [Hundred Sword].

100525.Title: For the Comrades
100525.Condition1:
Rauper was plagued by guilt because SangYeop had died because of him.
I left him behind and investigated the secret base to find Henry.
At the back of the secret base, I found him.
Henry set the Near SoulWorker: Raban on me.

100530.Title: Hundred Sword
100530.Condition1: As Raban was forced into a corner, he unleashed his power. Whilst he did so, Henry fled.
100530.Condition2: Fight against [Near SoulWorker: Raban] in [Hundred Sword]

100535.Title: Tidy Up
100535.Condition1:
Raban's property was secured.
The creatures that fled the secret base were all Near SoulWorkers. 
I got the mission to pursue them.
As the elite unit of the SFL was hot on the heels of Henry, I had to concentrate on Near SoulWorker
The SFL and the NED Company were now officially enemies.

100540.Title: Steel Enclosure
100540.Condition1: together with Kane Barrel, I made my way to the fallen steel fortress, the Ruin Fortress, where the Near SoulWorkers had fallen back to.
100540.Condition4: Move to your next destination: [Ruin Fortress].

100545.Title: Cold Air
100545.Condition1:
Kane Barrel and I followed the Near SoulWorkers to Ruin Fortress, a former military fortress of the NED Company Within the steel fortress, total silence reigned. There was not a soul to be seen, the fortress was empty.
The SFL was already there. After a short introduction I got a status report.
As the unit had been put together quickly, the facility itself had not yet been fully investigated.
Kane Barrel sighed in disbelief.

100550.Title: Girl's World
100550.Condition1: The camp and facilities were soon organized: The biggest problem is power control. The supply was intact, but the access was locked. Amanda determined that there would inevitably be an AI system to control facilities of this size. If control is not secured, nothing would be done. We found the AI's existence, and also the shuttles Near SoulWorker aboard were empty. They were already roaming the Ruin Fortress. The next job was to secure the  AI [Lucy] with the fear of fight against her.
100550.Condition2: Ask about the current whereabouts of [Near SoulWorker]

100555.Title: Crafted Resentment
100555.Condition1: Sarah said that an AI with its own consciousness could not be processed by just hardware only. Multiple Sub cores act in support of the central core. Lucy could not be hacked and was not cooperating. We wanted to destroy and reprogram her. The operation led us into the heart of the enemy. Even Kane Barrel was called back to Grace City because of an emergency call. I pushed in, destroyed the Sub AI Core and waited. But nobody in the camp could hack into them. Suddenly, a boy appeared.

100560.Title: A Lonesome Kid
100560.Condition1:
The boy was a refugee, who had been left behind somewhere in Ruin Fortress. His name was Abel. Despairing and scared, he stood there. I felt sorry for him, so I took him with me and returned to the camp.
A fight ignited between Martin, who did not trust the boy, and Amanda, who wanted to question him.

100565.Title: The Knights of a girl
100565.Condition1: Abel was the son of a researcher who had played a part in the development of Ruin Fortress. His family had lived there until the accident. Since this accident, nobody has lived in the Ruin Fortress anymore. Abel had survived on emergency rations in a secret room. Abel knew how the energy supply in the Ruin Fortress could be secured. Lucy, as an A. I, replace the human workload. If she gets deleted, we can take control back. We formatted Lucy, but there was another problem.

100570.Title: Three for One
100570.Condition1: Even though we had control, the power to operate the facility was far short. All we could do now was to open and close the door. Sarah said that this facility would not require any externals since it has functioned as a fortress. Abel agreed with her. The Ruin Fortress used Buster core as a source of energy, and there are three sub cores to support the main one, circulating power for all devices. Therefore, the power to activate Ruin Fortress would be enough when activating all sub cores.

100575.Title: Unanticipated Troublemaker
100575.Condition1:
There is a new problem. If a slave core was operated by a [stranger], then the other two consider it as an [enemy] and block it.
For this reason, Sarah wanted to also destroy these two slave cores, as with Lucy. As there was no option to activate these slave cores as [allies], the energy loss had to be accepted. Nobody knew what the Near SoulWorkers were up to. This search took priority.
After the slave cores were destroyed, a great deal of noise came from the camp. Abel has disappeared.

100580.Title: The Boy's Motives
100580.Condition1:
We located a sign of Abel in depth of Buster Core. What did he want there and why did he disappear? But first, we had to secure his property. 
Chloe was acting strangely throughout the search. The moment I was certain she was not being herself, I asked her to spill the beans. But suddenly Abel appeared by the control unit. We were surprised as Abel appeared in Buster Core.
He was a Near SoulWorker.

100585.Title: War & Blade
100585.Condition1:
Abel said that we had taken a load off his shoulders and then disappeared. We chased him and reached the depths of Buster Core. Abel was absorbing their energy. As I moved to stop Abel, the Near SoulWorker: [Noah] blocked my path.
The battle drew on a long time and Abel was able to absorb the entire energy load of Buster Core before he escaped with [Noah].
I returned to camp and saw the pale faces of the people there.

100590.Title: Follow the Light
100590.Condition1:
Without power the facility could barely be kept under control. In spite of this, we had to continue the search for the Near SoulWorkers and follow Abel.
Abel had absorbed the wave-formed energy in Buster Core. We followed his tracks and discovered a sign in the underground sector. He seemed to be luring us.
Then I saw the Shuttle Movement Route It did not seem to be wide enough...
At the end a large door blocked the path and I returned to the camp.

100595.Title: Sudden Encounter
100595.Condition1:
The door that blocked the path was locked. 
So I took a different route. Just as the search was getting boring, the following happened:
We ran into a NED Company troop in the Shuttle Movement Route
The battle was short. The troop leader was able to escape, but an old man remained, stood still and speechless. He seemed to be not confused nor scared. He was very calm, as if he had waited for this moment for a very long time.
100595.Condition4: Speak to [Suspicious old man] in [The Trail].

100600.Title: Racing Blue Flight Path
100600.Condition1: The elderly, Hicks, was a professor at the NED Company and was well-known as a bio-technologist throughout Cloudream. He would not reveal why he had approached the SFL. When we returned to the Shuttle Movement Route, Enoch, another Near SoulWorker was waiting at the large door. As same as Noah, Enoch did not use her full strength in combat. She said she had another ace up her sleeve. Then she fled. I checked the energy reaction levels across the door and recognized Abel's Buster Core energy.

100605.Title: Hidden Murder
100605.Condition1:
There was a massive arsenal of weapons behind the iron door. There were weapons stored there whose production had been banned by convention. This was evidence that the NED Company had prepared for a war against the SFL from the very start.
I got new information from Amanda. The measured energy reaction was stationary.
This had to mean that Abel had halted with Buster Core energy to prepare something else.

100610.Title: Blocking Lights
100610.Condition1: The coordinates of the energy reaction pointed to the depths of the Armory It was unclear what was waiting for me and just what plan Abel was following, yet I could not just stand idly by.

100615.Title: God of Machines
100615.Condition1:
I had to clear out some unmanned robots before I managed to reach the depths of the Armory Waiting for me there was a Giant robot that only had an upper body.
Once I had destroyed this Giant robot, controlled by Abel, he removed the core and made his escape. Then he said something strange:
[We will meet, finally...]

100620.Title: Into the Darkness
100620.Condition1:
I wanted to question Hicks about Abel. But he stayed silent. Martin stopped trying to gather more information and ordered the elimination of Near SoulWorker Hicks jumped in surprise. He begged us to wait. The time was not yet right.
Hicks believed that Abel intended to head to the real source of energy in Ruin Fortress, Deep Core
We reached the Deep Core beneath the Ruin Fortress. It reminded of an endless abyss.

100625.Title: Deeper and Deeper
100625.Condition1: Abel had absorbed Buster Core energy to activate Deux Ex Machina. He attacked me because he needed my Soul Energy. This anti-SoulWorker weapon absorbs the Soul Energy of SoulWorker when it fights against them. He intended to activate the Deep Core with the energy since only SoulWorkers could activate the Deep Core, so the member of NED Company Board is all SoulWorkers. Abel, an artificial SoulWorker, could be similar but could not be the same. Whatever he intends... we have to stop him.

100630.Title: Queen of Flower
100630.Condition1:
Noah was waiting for me in Deep Core. Unlike the previous encounter, this time she unleashed the true power of a Near SoulWorker. She even activated her [Exceed] to stop me.
Somehow I managed to overcome this might, but the Deep Core had already been activated.
Suddenly, things went very quiet. Then a tremendous tremor shook the Ruin Fortress.
According to Amanda, this tremor was the result of the drive being activated... but what will happen now?

100635.Title: Bloodbath Witch
100635.Condition1:
The excavator [Dig Monster] was the cause of the tremor. Seven of these excavators built Ruin Fortress in just a month. Abel wanted to use this to wake up Near SoulWorker prototype [Sion].
Sion was the strongest Near SoulWorker to date and had eradicated all life in Ruin Fortress. If she wakes, it would be the end.
It was unbelievable. But the escape of the NED Company was the proof.
To stop Sion's resurrection, the Dig Monster had to be stopped.
Without accounting for Abel.

100640.Title: Quaking Earth
100640.Condition1:
The Machine power was keep increasing.
It couldn't be defined where limit of its power ends.
I reached the place where the Dig Monster dug out of the ground. 
But it was already too late. 
 Sion rose to the surface with a light that seemed to tear the sky apart.
Both Abel and Sion had disappeared.
Fortunately, Sion seemingly had not come to her full senses with a side effect of the disempowerment. 
It was not yet too late.
Not yet.

100645.Title: Scattering Infinity
100645.Condition1:
As I pushed into the military research centre to secure Sion, I bumped into Enoch. She said that Abel and Sion were with her and that we should end this, for once and for all.
I hurried to the location, but it was all a lie. Abel and Sion had already fled to a safe location and Enoch was trying to gain time by activating her Exceed.
It was very discomforting to know how much time I lost there.
The others felt the same way.

100650.Title: The Ark
100650.Condition1:
We entered into a construction. We had to stop Abel and prevent Sion's full resurrection.
[The Ark] was a secret project of the NED Company, made to create SoulWorkers.
Sion was a Near SoulWorker prototype who had wiped out the entire Ruin Fortress.
Project leader, Hicks realised that these creatures were also merely children.
He wanted to gift them a normal life.
A spaceship had been built in the construction that we were to halt the awakening of the Bloodbath Witch.

100655.Title: The Confession
100655.Condition1:
Hicks had disappeared. 
It happened on the way to the construction of Ark Ship
Amanda supported him to get involved. 
Even she knew that he would die. she wants him to pay for such experiment. 
However, Martin said that this man should repent for his actions in pain.
I hurried to the Ark Ship to save Hicks. Jake from NED Company was with him. 
He was injured by Jake. I defeated Jake and hurried to Help him: But I was too late. 
He lamented himself as idle bystander and closed his eyes.

100660.Title: Fatal
100660.Condition1:
Seal away Sion. Leave the remaining Near SoulWorkers alive. The targets were clear. The preparations were in progress. I went to the Ark Ship
Abel was defeated and Sion almost sealed. But Abel let out a cry and Sion awoke. Furious. Unreachable. I was Clearly Helpless. As Sion attacked, a golden light burst out around us. Then nothing more.
Just a familiar voice... and then black. In the camp Martin asked what happened, but I did not know. I asked myself the same question.

100670.Title: What happened so far...
100670.Condition1:
When the din of battle had faded, nothing was left except Clean air and emptiness. It was as if Sion and all the other Near SoulWorkers had been swallowed up by the ground. 
Such powers had collided in the battle between Sion and that strange golden creature that a blazing void had formed. We lost the Near SoulWorkers' trail in the ensuing chaos. The investigation team from Ruin Fortress and I pursued another trail: a gigantic Vacuum that we could now enter with no trouble.
100670.Condition2: Speak to [Amanda] and [Sarah] in the [Ruin Fortress] and unearth the truth.

100675.Title: Suspicious Vacuum
100675.Condition1:
We carefully made our way into the alternate Vacuum. Corruption and devastation stretched away before our eyes and the sky glowed with a Sinister light. Nothing moved. Vacuum had drained the last drop of life from the city.
The investigations were progressing at full speed on the other side. The SFL commander introduced me to someone who had returned from the dead five years before: Tenebris, the first of all SoulWorkers. The legend began with him.

100680.Title: The Strongest SoulWorker
100680.Condition1: Tenebris spoke in riddles. When he saw that I couldn't remember anything, he fell silent and only glanced at me with distrust. All in all, a pretty strange welcome.

100685.Title: Lightless Ember
100685.Condition1: The first thing we came across in Casual Raid were the Vessi from Rapid Flame Assault Squad, who we'd already encountered in Grace City. I thought the Void had sucked them in just as it had those Helpless people before. But Tenebris saw things very differently.

100690.Title: Auditory Hallucination
100690.Condition1:
The Spirit Pathfinder were rendered inoperable. [Soul Energy couldn't be recognized] and Amanda, who'd taken over communications, began to hear strange voices on the line. The Vacuum had been waiting for us. What were we to do?
I continued slogging onwards and kept coming across remnants of Rapid Flame Assault Squad. Then I saw the unforgettable entity from long ago: Code name [Tempester]. The enemy was leeching energy with these monsters. I quickly destroyed all the Tempesters I could reach.
100690.Condition2: Speak to [Amanda] and [Tenebris], then defeat the Vessi.

100695.Title: Fortune Corps. Landing
100695.Condition1: All of the strewn Rapid Flame Monsters had been defeated. Time to breathe out, even in Casual Raid. This meant Fortune Corps could be stationed securely and we even finally exchanged a few words with Miriam again. But something in her was unsettled. Did she knew something about Tenebris and was keeping?

100700.Title: Horrible Echo
100700.Condition1:
Once the Vessi were dealt with, the investigation team discovered an unexplored sector.
I found myself in an illusory splinter world again and kept meeting the same monsters in an illusory version of Rocco Town.

100705.Title: Desire's Terrritory
100705.Condition1:
Tenebris listened attentively to my report. All of this wasn't unusual in the void, this was [Desire Energy territory] after all. It draws in all in its path, till all logical thought ends and only lust remains.
Martin replied that it was indeed curious how Desire Energy and Soul Energy could collide without the latter vanishing. Tenebris wasted no words on the subject.
Miriam was no longer trying to get through to Tenebris. Things seem very complicated.

100710.Title: Clown in the Mist
100710.Condition1: The illusion sector was still active and obviously the one and only had to show up: Edgar. I was still brimming with rage at our last encounter. So I went back into the illusion sector to defeat his last illusion once and for all. I'd barely set foot in the sector when I heard a totally foreign yet familiar voice speak to me words heavy with meaning.

100715.Title: Justice of Each
100715.Condition1:
According to Tenebris it was the voice of my [Shadow], a kind of [manifested past]. Since it wasn't possible to listen to this voice without complications, Tenebris said, I should leave the area as quickly as possible.
Shocked by this news, I turned to Miriam for advice.

100720.Title: Past and Present
100720.Condition1: Miriam's words were warm and simple. No matter what the Shadow said, it all belonged to yesterday and the me of today was someone Clearly different. I thanked her and immediately began my hunt for the illusions.
100720.Condition2: Take a deep breath and Speak to [Tenebris].

After calming the residents, I returned to Grace City to look for Roy.

Toru claimed they had taken [leave]. But could that really be the truth?

100735.Title: Emergency Call
100735.Condition1:
Every item on the agenda seemed to come to nothing, the network of our research remained hazy, and doom seemed to hang over everyone there. Then Toru received an urgent message.
A new incident in the Void.
Grasscover Camp received reports of E.S.P Corps disappearing one by one.
Roy's interrogation continued, but we couldn't accept any more damage. The decision was taken to return to Grasscover Camp together with Kane Barrel.

100740.Title: The Man-Eating Park
100740.Condition1:
We followed the track of the vanished E.S.P Corps to a huge, splendid park.
But what first seemed like a Garden of Eden to us soon turned out to be a trap. E.S.P Corps were mercilessly overwhelmed in the battle against the beasts of this man-eating park.
We quickly hurried past the horrible sight. Then Amanda suddenly fell into an extremely disturbing state...

100745.Title: Worst Circumstance
100745.Condition1:
In Grasscover Camp, E.S.P Corps were affected by similar symptoms to those in the park.
Somehow, Amanda recovered thanks to Martin's Help and Miriam thanks to Tenebris.
Alarmed by these events, we hurried back to the park to seek the missing people as quickly as possible.

100750.Title: Rescue Mission
100750.Condition1:
We found them. Bound hand and foot, they were barely conscious.
They screamed, “My Lord Vacuum!” and fell deeper into a trance.
What was going on here?!

100755.Title: Tragedy of the Night Sky
100755.Condition1:
Everyone was safe. Martin made the following suggestion.
We would return and observe. As soon as all of the E.S.P Corps banded together, we would capture the whole pack.
The man was right. Chasing after them individually was impossible.
Martin told the [Tragedy of the Night Sky].
It was about a SoulWorker who had created Hell on Earth five years ago. Of course, it was Tenebris, who was now over there slurping his coffee.
100755.Condition2: Speak to certain people until the end of the investigations.

100760.Title: The Second Advance
100760.Condition1:
Kane Barrel and I prepared ourselves for any surprise and set out for the park.
We could still see where they had fled, but were forced to retreat because of Kane Barrel's relapse.
100760.Condition2: Clear [The Hunting Field of Predator] in [Maneater Garden]

100765.Title: Reason to risk a life
100765.Condition1:
Most of E.S.P Corps were back in safety. But the next steps were unclear, because no one could estimate the risk.
And the few aides had moved out of the Void, which made proceeding further a lot Harder.
Martin appealed directly to me. Would I still carry on fighting?
Of course. I came to fight. Martin, Amanda, Miriam, Sedurin and Kane Barrel assured me of their support and said we would advance side by side.
100765.Condition2: Speak to certain people in [Grasscover Camp].

100770.Title: Deadmeat Factory
100770.Condition1:
Hot on the heels of the missing people, we tracked them to an abandoned factory.
What we found was not a sight for anyone with weak nerves. Many of our missing SFL soldiers had wasted away there and mutated into undead.

100775.Title: Catastrophe
100775.Condition1:
The sight was heartbreaking. Decayed beyond recognition, the E.S.P Corps wanted to tear us to pieces. Fighting and gasping, I asked Sedurin for a test of those who had been condemned to undeath.
These League soldiers had been infected with Desire Energy and died of it. If we didn't find our missing people soon, this excruciating process would also happen to them.
But ultimately we had no option. There was only one way out for them.
100775.Condition2: Search [Those who driven by Desire] in [Deadmeat Factory]

100780.Title: Kent
100780.Condition1:
Tenebris suddenly remembered a tale.
It was about a man named Kent. From the description, he was the same sort as Roy, who had left a very definite impression.
So we needed to watch out for him, because he knew every dirty trick in the book.
100780.Condition2: Speak to [Tenebris] and [Martin] and find a solution.

100785.Title: Leaver's Record I
100785.Condition1:
And once again, it was back to the horrible factory. 
Waiting for us there was Roy, who sent a [Red monster] against us.
As it lay there defeated, for a moment it seemed to take on human features again. It stammered “Tene...” and handed me a note.
100785.Condition2: Search [Abandoned Road of Savior] in [Deadmeat Factory]

100790.Title: Leaver's Record II
100790.Condition1:
The note was from none other than Lord. When I mentioned that name to Martin and Tenebris, they were horrified. Then I heard his story.
Thirteen years ago, this Lord created the SFL. That same year, someone tried to assasinate him.
No one was able to explain how this person could have wound up in Roy's power.

100795.Title: Expectations and plan
100795.Condition1:
Roy met us with a broad grin. It was disgusting how happy he was at our reunion!
He left us with the puzzling remark that this was for our efforts and disappeared. Then we saw that he had actually freed some hostages.

100800.Title: Despaired rests
100800.Condition1:
Once again, we were at a dead end. The number of victims grew mercilessly.
With gloomy expressions, we admitted defeat for the moment and headed straight back to Grace City.

100805.Title: Thirst for Revenge
100805.Condition1:
Grace City had to mourn a Clear E.S.P Corps. To say nothing of the security of the city.
In comparison, Candus City had taken little damage and was promptly asked for Help. Beneris, another SoulWorker, and I were sent to fetch Help.
We had scarcely reached Candus City when two more pieces of the puzzle fell into place: Beneris and... Henry!
