100810.Title: Dipluce Port City
100810.Condition1:
Aaron was lost the moment Henry's name dropped. Nerve by nerve, he inched towards breaking point, but he kept listening to Beneris' words.
Henry had gone into hiding in Dipluce, the port city steeped in legend. He was hoping he could win over the Soul Junk queen for himself, in order to wipe out humanity for good.
Brooke urgently warned us of the horror that would await us there. But Aaron was not be dissuaded from his pursuit of Henry. And so I, too, had no other choice.

100815.Title: Aerial Domination
100815.Condition1:
Dipluce Horizon was destroyed. Not a trace of the port city's great beauty remained to be seen. Darkness drifted over the place and the Soul Junk were spreading their plague.
The desolate hole at the docks gaped at us, toothless and eyeless, only a few steps away from the water. I didn't want to put up our tent there at all. Brooke wanted to tackle the highest building to secure the camp. She was right... damn.

100820.Title: Outraged Person
100820.Condition1:
The last security rampart was now standing. Having just returned to the quarters, Aaron's temper flared and he gave one of Soldiers a rollicking.
His offence had been to dare ask for a different post. Aaron didn't stop swearing. No war could be led this way, let alone won.
At times like that, every one of us was cannon fodder.

100825.Title: The World of the Unholy
100825.Condition1:
In silence, Aaron contemplated the amulet with the portrait of his daughter. He had changed. With a cold inner rage, he lost more and more of the fatherliness with which he had always lead us.
The report about the massacre that he had arranged with our troops hung over the camp like a stale shroud. With foresight, Brooke had been able to rescue some of those doomed to their deaths. There was hardly a trace of the fighting spirit we had at the start.

100830.Title: Incomprehensible
100830.Condition1:
We then busied ourselves with the larger Soul Junk lurking between the buildings. These places didn't constitute any important positions but Aaron insisted we gather more battle data.
Again he was sending us into the fray without any apparent battle plan. And we followed him blindly.
100830.Condition2: Clear [Mission: Soul Junk Elimination] in [Sky Walker].

100835.Title: Calm Before the Storm
100835.Condition1: Once the camp was set up, every movement was concentrated on the eerie Sinkhole on the pier, or the Unholy Hole as we called it. Its depth was immeasurable and we would find ourselves in an unsecured danger zone. In order to get the equipment necessary for the descent, we went to see Major Toru in the Ruin Fortress.

100840.Title: Something Busy
100840.Condition1:
In the Ruin Fortress, Toru asserted that he had seen Near SoulWorkers there. He was so sure about it that he didn't even crack any jokes. But Martin didn't want to know.
What on earth was going on here? My mission was pressing, however, and so I made my way back to Dipluce Horizon just as artfully as I had before.

100845.Title: Trans Corps. Navy Fleet
100845.Condition1:
The transport ship that set sail with our equipment had to overcome a difficult passage with deep sea Soul Junk.
An strange foreboding crept up on me and I headed in the direction of the pier.

100850.Title: Consecutive Disobedience
100850.Condition1:
He was there... The soldier that Brooke saved from certain death during the last mission. He was talking to Gruwell.
Gruwell made no secret of his anger towards Aaron, but with Brooke's words of encouragement he didn't do anything stupid. Not yet.
In this constricting atmosphere, Victor suddenly came bursting in with his unwavering urge to push ahead with the research by using the fallen... It felt like we were in the wrong film.

100855.Title: Resistanting Voice
100855.Condition1:
Aaron's dreadful moods took became more and more violent in nature. He shouted Brooke personally responsible for the fact that he couldn't relax during the rest period, and shouted incessantly at anyone who crossed his path.
For how long would we be able to hold the camp under this atmosphere? The tension was gradually becoming unbearable.

100860.Title: Invisible Cracks
100860.Condition1:
The second transport ship had arrived and we threw ourselves into the consignment, grateful for the change of scenery.
Somewhere close by, there was rustling from lots of indiscernible movements, but we paid no attention to it.
100860.Condition2: Clear [Rescue Mission: The 2nd Fleet] in [Transport Fleet].

100865.Title: Usable Tools
100865.Condition1: While we were full of enthusiasm busying ourselves with the construction for the descent, Aaron was still smouldering with hate. It was like being the bird and the horse who were mistreated underground, as the story goes.

100870.Title: Day of Liberation
100870.Condition1:
The monotone construction of the camp and the concentrated preparations for the descent became more and more of a Tormented. Then it happened. One of the ships set sail with a team, without having received orders to do so.
Beneris insisted we push on with the preparations, and let the deserters go. But as Lieutenant Colonel Aaron's amulet was nowhere to be found, the situation boiled over Clearly.

100875.Title: The Only Memory
100875.Condition1: Then came the order to pursue the pathetic thieves, and to hunt them down in their new refuge, an uninhabited island. Our friends had been declared our enemies, and their community renamed the 'Unholy'. And I was part of the execution commando...
100875.Condition2: Speak to [Gruwell] in [Betrayers' Region] of [Betrayers' Army]

100910.Title: A Way of Saying Farewell
100910.Condition1: Lieutenant Colonel Aaron said he experienced a lot during this affair, and presented me with an amulet that was important to him. Inside the amulet, there was a...

100915.Title: Endless Investigation
100915.Condition1: Aaron regretted his actions and decided to withdraw his troops from Dipluce. But the situation wasn't so simple.

100920.Title: Orders from Above
100920.Condition1: Despite Aaron's request to abort, the Lords are going ahead with the operation in Dipluce. The SFL doesn't seem to be interested in sorting this matter out.

100925.Title: Sacred Battlefield
100925.Condition1: When the installation of the descent transporter began, Nihill Kingdom soldiers attacked suddenly. Nobody knows why. For the moment, you've got no choice other than to stop them.

100930.Title: A captive female knight
100930.Condition1: During the fight against Nihill Kingdom, you were able to keep a Vessi named Arua safe. You try to have a talk with her.

100935.Title: The Nihill Kingdom Commander
100935.Condition1: The attack by Nihill Kingdom on the camp is still continuing. But with Arua's Help you manage to defeat your opponents.

100940.Title: For Honor
100940.Condition1:
The Nihill Kingdom Vessi were intending to rescue their King's daughter, to whom they had sworn their loyalty. The same was true of Arua.
But we couldn't give up, either, as long as the suspicion remained that this princess could be the Soul Junk Queen.

100945.Title: The Best of All
100945.Condition1: At last, a direct fight against Arculus. How do you defeat a commander with [Comrade Revival] at his disposal?

100950.Title: The First Hurdle
100950.Condition1: After victory over the Nihill Kingdom Army, the installation of the descent transporter could finally be Cleard. The advance guard, who were the first to board the descent transporter, discovered a NED Company laboratory. A sense of unease meant we didn't press forward, but investigated it instead.

570005.Title: Destiny Again I
570005.Condition1: The Wheel of Destiny grinds once more. It is curtains up for a new path... to a world far, far away.

570007.Title: Destiny Again II
570007.Condition1: The Wheel of Destiny grinds once more. It is curtains up for a new path... to a world far, far away.

570010.Title: A child called SoulWorker
570010.Condition1:
SoulWorker... that sounds so unusual. 
And this strange power the SoulWorkers have? I bet they save countless lives.

570015.Title: Will of Protector
570015.Condition1: SoulWorkers are people with the power to protect people. I was convinced that it was the power with which I would be able to save this world.

570020.Title: Wandering Memory
570020.Condition1: Nothing. When I close my eyes, I see nothing... When everything trickles away, only the memory of those who were there can Help.

570025.Title: I am a cat
570025.Condition1: One thing is certain: as a cat I can only do what a cat can.

570030.Title: Named
570030.Condition1: I wear my name on my heart. My memory tells me nothing of this name except certainty.

570035.Title: The Conspiracy
570035.Condition1: Summoned by the NED Company, I headed to the agreed location, only there... was none other than Rauper.

570040.Title: Protector of the world
570040.Condition1: An unbelievable whisper spreads among the ranks of Starry Forest: the NED Company was not founded on gold. It was in pursuit of an aim that reached deeper than the understanding of time. It aims to keep hope alive, at all costs.

570045.Title: Hatefuld by All
570045.Condition1: The battle in Grace City cost too many sacrifices to count. In SFL there was nobody that bore this so heavily as one specific soul.

570050.Title: Left
570050.Condition1: Hicks remains missing without a trace. In his place sit only silence and melancholy.

570055.Title: What Remains After
570055.Condition1: The battle with Near SoulWorker: Sion was devastating.

570060.Title: Desire Worker
570060.Condition1: They call themselves Desire Worker. They looked like Clearly normal SoulWorkers.

570065.Title: In Their Case
570065.Condition1: Desire Workers seeked out a mere existence of shadows, yet in the world of conciousness they were mighty. Why should they keep fighting? Then they started to talk, one after the other.

800005.Title: Home in the East
800005.Condition1: 2nd Generation SoulWorkers; they're manmade SoulWorkers that the East has been training for 10 years. Each one of them follows someone they call [Godmother] and drive Energy through devotion to Starry Forest League and love for their individual [Godmothers].

800010.Title: 2nd Generation SoulWorker
800010.Condition1: I, [Ain], will look over these 2nd Generation SoulWorkers who have all just woken up in their individual Personal rooms as one who manages them all.

800012.Title: The First Evaluation
800012.Condition1: The Battle Evaluation for these 2nd Generation SoulWorkers has begun; not many of them will make it to the end.
800012.Condition2: Proceed with Battle Evaluation in [Soldier Border] of [Cloud Border]

800015.Title: Approved Break
800015.Condition1: I've made them get acquainted with [Merchants' Union] that the Starry Forest League Headquarters has personally transferred over here. It looks like there are people working illegally mixed in with the others but I guess it's not like SFL to care about that sort of thing taking into account that they're debuting these 2nd Generation SoulWorkers into the world in ten years.
800015.Condition2: [Taking in the situation while walking around]

800020.Title: The Significance of a SoulWorker
800020.Condition1: As this test assumes real situations, it may have been a tight and difficult schedule for normal Supernaturals but 2nd Generation SoulWorkers can work almost as much as actual SoulWorkers with only a small window of rest; it's wouldn't be an understatement to say that they have limitless potential if funded properly.
800020.Condition2: Proceed with Battle Evaluation in [Monsters' Territory] of [Cloud Border]

800025.Title: Progress Beyond Expectation
800025.Condition1: I've told the 2nd Generations about the realities of Starry Forest League. They certainly seem to have been trained quite well; they're accepting everything they're hearing.
800025.Condition2: Proceed with Battle Evaluation in [Outside the Borders] of [Cloud Border]

800030.Title: Imitations
800030.Condition1: The 2nd Generations had a lot of conversation with many different people during their break. Although they're 2nd Generation, they still have the label of a [SoulWorker] so it seems that there's still some kind of reaction to that label.
800030.Condition2: Get some rest at [Tower of Lord]

800035.Title: Special Missions Unit
800035.Condition1: I've used the name [Bernard] in order to hide myself and work here in the West changing myself beyond recognition. The 2nd Generation SoulWorkers have also been renamed as [Bernard Special Missions Unit].
800035.Condition2: Proceed with Battle Evaluation in [Attacked Village] of [Broken Way]

800040.Title: Strong Child of Steel
800040.Condition1: Hero Armor… a hopeful one I've had my eye on since the beginning… Some of the Missions Unit aren't a fan of someone calling themselves a hero but I think it's quite honest of oneself; I'm quite a fan.
800040.Condition2: Proceed with Battle Evaluation in [Fading Flames] of [Broken Way]

800045.Title: Godmother
800045.Condition1: Looks like that old woman's called out a 2nd Generation again. Ugh. Well, I mean, it's probably like a vacation for a 2nd Generation to have conversations with their beloved Godmothers.
800045.Condition2: Get some rest at [Tower of Lord]

800050.Title: Someone from ESP
800050.Condition1: I've requested for Varbir to be transferred into the Special Missions Unit; he's still only an everyday Supernatural but I've seen some strong determination and potential in him, so I hired him. I'm expecting him to fill in for the 2nd Generations who failed the Evaluations and were sent back.
800050.Condition2: Proceed with Battle Evaluation in [Stench of War] of [Broken Way]

800055.Title: Meaningless Something
800055.Condition1: Looks like that old woman's saying useless stuff to the 2nd Generation SoulWorker again; looks like not much has changed since the training facilities.

800060.Title: The Last Evaluation
800060.Condition1: The final evaluation for the 2nd Generation SoulWorkers has been completed. Their minds were more for doing their best for their Godmothers as opposed to for humanity or Starry Forest League. I mean, if it's a way for them to create Energy, then it really doesn't matter.
800060.Condition2: Proceed with Battle Evaluation in [Final Mission] of [Broken Way]

800065.Title: Disharmony
800065.Condition1: Not many have lasted till the end; they're not getting along great either which creates worries about what'll happen in the future.

800070.Title: Planning Mode
800070.Condition1: The first place we headed to was [Grace City] in the West. A not-so-pleased looking commander named [Toru] greeted the Special Missions Unit. It definitely seemed like he wasn't too pleased about working with the East but he seemed to stay quiet because it was Lords' orders. Whether big or small, the East and West are certainly going to be having some troubles constantly.
800070.Condition2: Go to [Grace City] to proceed with Special Missions Unit orders

800075.Title: To the Place Most Dangerous
800075.Condition1: The mission given to the 2nd Generation SoulWorkers was to investigate the Vacuum. The purpose of this mission was to investigate SoulWorkers in the West along with the Vacuum's Energy to figure out how to become a real SoulWorker. So, we headed to the [safe Alternate Vacuum] otherwise known as [Grasscover Camp] through Rocco Town.

800080.Title: Inside the Vacuum
800080.Condition1: When we arrived inside the Vacuum, a small number of the Investigation Team were already running the base camp; it seemed as though a lot had happened before we got there. The commander of the Investigation Team, [Martin], saw through my disguise but gave me his word to not report me; the only thing that would result from that would be him being rid of by Lords anyway.

800085.Title: A Way to get Stronger
800085.Condition1: The spirit of the Legendary SoulWorker [Tenebris] was around so the 2nd Generations had a conversation with him but I don't think there was much to take from it. Rather, it seems like Tenebris was just telling them that it was impossible to become a real SoulWorker...

800090.Title: The Determined Doll
800090.Condition1: Thanks to Tenebris, it looks like the whole Special Missions Unit has been given quite the pessimistic outlook on everything. I still don't understand why they don't get that the worst thing that could happen is death.

800095.Title: A Good Place
800095.Condition1: Martin's said he's going to show us a [good place] saying that he had his doubts about the Special Missions Unit.
800095.Condition2: Speak to many people in [Grasscover Camp]

800100.Title: The Place Wrapped with Hallucinations
800100.Condition1: The place Martin brought us to was an abandoned subway station. The 2nd Generation SoulWorkers started seeing hallucinations of their Godmothers; it was quite a harsh method but proved that much more efficient.

800105.Title: The Lying Voice
800105.Condition1: Some of them cut off the investigation clean giving in to the hallucinations while the others realized what was going on and continued on; there still hasn't been a single case of a perfect SoulWorker yet.

800110.Title: Negotiations with a Spirit
800110.Condition1: I've come to the conclusion that there's not much progress so I've put the investigation on pause; I've made it so that gathering information on the Vacuum is more important as of now.
800110.Condition2: Clear [Reunion with a Soft Soul] in [Dreadful Echo]

800115.Title: The Unchanging
800115.Condition1: I simply wanted to talk to Tenebris about the days to come but he only talked about how kids that try to mimic SoulWorkers can never truly be a SoulWorker. Now, of course, I'm aware of this at the back of my head; I'm just not in a position where I can give up.

800120.Title: Once Again to the Spirit
800120.Condition1: After hearing news of a garden that lures people in with hallucinations, our Special Missions Unit went straight in for investigation; as expected, the hallucinations greeted us as if it were waiting.

800125.Title: The Spirit and the Hallucination
800125.Condition1: Due to the duration of the garden investigation, there have been more Special Missions Unit members being influenced by the hallucinations.

800130.Title: According to the Predator
800130.Condition1: The Vacuum's hallucinations that have been attacking the Special Missions Unit have disappeared and in their place, the real Godmother's shown her face… why, though?
800130.Condition2: Clear [The Hunting Field of Predator] in [Maneater Garden]

800135.Title: The First Star
800135.Condition1: It looks like she's being pushed around by the real thing. Now that Lords have showed up, there's nothing I can do.

800140.Title: The Proud Child
800140.Condition1: I've lost all control over this Unit; it's probably a good thing that they're exerting so much Soul Energy due to the emotions the Godmother is provoking but… it may be a little dangerous if it continues on like this.

800145.Title: Blind Desire
800145.Condition1: Lured by her Godmother, this 2nd Generation SoulWorker's gone to the factory while completely ignoring my orders; something needs to be done about this.

800150.Title: Blind Desire II
800150.Condition1: … I've followed them unknowingly and attacked them forcefully bringing them back.

800155.Title: Another Planned Road I
800155.Condition1: The Unit's been somewhat calmed as of now but it'll only get worse from here. The question of whether to evacuate or carry on like this is a big one….
800155.Condition2: [You look for a way to better yourself]

800160.Title: Another Planned Road II
800160.Condition1: A choice has been granted to the Unit; whether to deny oneself and change for the better or to accept oneself…
800160.Condition2: Head to [Rocco Town] and speak to [Miriam]

800165.Title: Another Planned Road III
800165.Condition1: The Special Missions Unit had headed to an unknowable place with the help of Tenebris. I'm not quite sure what they saw or heard there but… their expressions were definitely not the same when they returned.
800165.Condition2:
Head to [Abandoned Grave] 
※ Transportation available through [Shard Withholding Darkness] item from Inventory

800170.Title: Another Planned Road IV
800170.Condition1: I talked about the Godmothers as I walked with the Special Missions Unit. To me, they're all just a bunch of strict old women but I guess to them, they're saviors that have been with them for ten years.

800175.Title: Another Planned Road V
800175.Condition1: The Godmothers that they've seen are all just hallucinations specific to them. After cutting out the hallucinations and returning to reality, they've all made the decision to walk the path they've been on.
800175.Condition2:
Head to [Abandoned Grave] having speaking to [Eo]
※ Transportation available through [Shard Withholding Darkness] item from Inventory

800180.Title: The Restarted Special Missions Unit
800180.Condition1: After the whole hallucination disturbance had come to a cease, we decided to head for the harbor city Dipluce following SoulWorkers of the West.

800185.Title: To the Broken Harbor City
800185.Condition1: We've started planning a new operation for the city of Dipluce along with new members Aaron and Brooke. I haven't seen Beneris in a while but it seems as though he's not intending on interacting with me at all.

800190.Title: SoulJunk-a-phobe
800190.Condition1: We've met someone named Victor; he absolutely loathes Soul Junk. I guess it's not a weird thing to loathe them so much in a time like this.

800195.Title: A New Mission
800195.Condition1: Soul Junk have suddenly started attacking the base camp; we've decided to give as much help as we can even if to protect the Sink Hole investigation.
800195.Condition2: Clear [Scout Mission: Advanced Party] in [Sky Walker]

800200.Title: New Pain
800200.Condition1: The Special Missions Unit is in high spirits after going through the Grasscover Camp incident; it's not the worst thing but I'm afraid it may lead to unnecessary mistakes.
800200.Condition2: Clear [Mission: Activating Anti-Aircraft Gun] in [Sky Walker] after speaking to [Bernard]

800205.Title: The Difference This Time
800205.Condition1: Counter-consciousness… There's no question that the Special Missions Unit will live up to SoulWorkers in the West. Lords' mission shall be completed safely and definitely… There's no need to put your life on the line like SoulWorkers from that time, though...
800205.Condition2: Clear [Mission: Soul Junk Elimination] in [Sky Walker] after speaking to [Bernard]

800210.Title: Unending Invasions
800210.Condition1: The Soul Junk attacking the base camp have somewhat ceased but something else is now threatening us.

800215.Title: Back to the Sea
800215.Condition1: Soul Junk from the sea have started attacking the base camp. There must be an explanation as to why these Soul Junk are actively attacking all of a sudden…
800215.Condition2: Clear [Defense Mission: The 1st Fleet] in [Transport Fleet]

800220.Title: Monsters of the Horizon
800220.Condition1: Another massive Soul junk from the sea has made its appearance. The Special Missions Unit has an abundance of confidence after having taken down a massive Soul Junk in the past.

800225.Title: Unending Loathe
800225.Condition1: The guy called Victor is trying many things purely on the background that he has a burning hatred for Soul Junk… I guess we'll have to wait and see what will come of it, though.

800230.Title: Betrayers' Ground
800230.Condition1: Victor's left the base camp alone acting completely apart from the rest; the Special Missions Unit has followed him to see what's going on. I'm sure that he's keeping in touch with…

800235.Title: A Deeper Darkness
800235.Condition1: I've commanded that the Special Missions Unit keep following Victor; there was much confidence in his voice when telling us we'd only be making it hard for ourselves the more we kept following him.

800240.Title: The Third Star
800240.Condition1: What we caught on the island was Lords' Third Star, Vista. She may look like only a kid on the outside, but it's best to beware.

800245.Title: Cherry Blossom Offspring
800245.Condition1: Although she got caught by us, she invited herself to stay at the base camp. She's one of the mass produced humans created by Cherry Blossom… and a genius at that born at the smallest possibility; there are too many things I'm not happy about her.

800250.Title: Holy, Dirty Land
800250.Condition1: Upon news of Nihill Kingdom's remnants who are usually only seen in the East are gearing up to battle, we started preparing for a counterattack.

800255.Title: Corrupted Military
800255.Condition1: Comrades have been brought back from the dead by the powers of the Head General Arculus… Why all of a sudden?
800255.Condition2: Speak to [Martin] in [Tainted with Blood of Honor]

800260.Title: What Stubbornness leads to
800260.Condition1: The Special Missions Unit have gone with Vista and Martin to check the situation themselves; it seems they've brought back a bunch of useful data.

800265.Title: The Anticipation and its Wandering Borders
800265.Condition1: There's no more reason to stay here thanks to a SoulWorker from the West having failed this mission… But Lords seem like they still want something resulting in us staying here longer.

800270.Title: The Suspicious Lab
800270.Condition1: We've gotten the opportunity to use the lift to get down to the Sink Hole to investigate further.

800275.Title: Tag
800275.Condition1: Vista's disappeared from the base camp… she probably jumped down while the lift wasn't moving… she's definitely not normal.

800280.Title: The Wrong Person… Again
800280.Condition1: The parasitic Soul Junk that plugs tentacles in human bodies to suck out Soul Energy… definitely the number one enemy of Supernaturals and SoulWorkers alike; it looks like NED Co was researching something rather grand down here.

800285.Title: Deeper
800285.Condition1: After acquiring all data available from the research lab inside the Sink Hole, we were able to investigate the Mithraeum that was supposedly deeper down.

800290.Title: The Dead of the Cold
800290.Condition1: That annoying Vista's stayed behind underneath the Sink Hole again. I'd rather she just die or something; I have no idea what she's trying to even do.

800295.Title: Horrific Repetition
800295.Condition1: A complete entity by bringing a parasitic Soul Junk and a human together… Aaron's been pretty shocked by this; it looks like something's happened before.

800300.Title: Weak Hatred
800300.Condition1: The First Star, Ysabella, has suddenly appeared in Dipluce… Why is this old spinster here all of a sudden?

800305.Title: A Higher Star
800305.Condition1: We've been forced into investigating the Sink Hole a little longer because of this old spinster's orders; she looks like she's expecting something but it's hard to tell what's really going on in that mind of hers.

800310.Title: The Other Godmother
800310.Condition1: I've been getting reports from the Special Missions Unit saying they've been seeing the Illusion of Tenebris; there's something going on in the Sink Hole for sure.
800310.Condition2: Clear [Heroes' Failure] in [Dawn of Fate] after speaking to [Aaron]

800315.Title: Final Nocturne League
800315.Condition1: The investigation is continuing on; there's been more and more reports on spotting the Illusion of Tenebris.

800320.Title: Failure I
800320.Condition1: That old spinster is insisting on going to meet [Tenebris] herself… along with the Unit… They won't die or anything, right?

800325.Title: Failure II
800325.Condition1: The Unit's reported they've battled Tenebris, but it's only his Illusion.

800330.Title: The Ways of the West
800330.Condition1: There's nothing left to investigate in the Sink Hole and now the Unit's gotten orders from Lords… to go to the West and continue to take orders from Lords…
800330.Condition2: Investigate the West after heading to [Grace City]

800335.Title: Launch of Investigation of Snowy Mountains
800335.Condition1: I've checked the situation in Grace City and I was right about those in the West not wanting anything to do with us from the East. Toru seems to want nothing to do with us so we had to get help from the Operational Officer, Senia.

800340.Title: Hiding in the Shadows
800340.Condition1: The investigation of the Snow-Covered Mountains where enemies have allegedly been spotted has been continuing. We've prepared lots of winter supplies due to the cold.

800345.Title: A New Evaluation
800345.Condition1: An experiement using humans who've already half-turned to Soul Junk… Vista's using a human named Relfenne as if she were her playtoy.

800350.Title: Yet Another Conspiracy
800350.Condition1: Vista went so far to tell Toru that she'd go back to bring Flemma back from the dead. Obviously, Toru was furious but there was literally nothing he could do but to cooperate with Lords.

800355.Title: Into the Steel Fortress
800355.Condition1: We entered NED's research facilities to bring Flemma back from the dead. Vista just looks too excited to be able to toy with Flemma.

800360.Title: Scientist's Desire
800360.Condition1: I was always the one suffering at Lords' every single little order and now I'm the Special Missions Unit.

800365.Title: Incomplete Ressurection
800365.Condition1: All preparations are in place; I'm just praying that whatever that kid has planned goes smoothly.

800370.Title: Reblooming fireworks I
800370.Condition1: Alright, let's try waking up Flemma. I guess the only ones aware of the results would be Lords who put these orders in place.

800375.Title: Reblooming Fireworks II
800375.Condition1: The now awake Flemma has absolutely no  idea what's going on; she'd never guess in her wildest dreams that the one who killed her is the one who brought her back to life.

800380.Title: Atonement or Condemnation
800380.Condition1: No one in Grace City was happy about the fact that Flemma was brought back to life; I mean, who would.

800385.Title: An Exchange
800385.Condition1: The first thing Flemma commanded was to [fight alongside her minions until death]. It was impossible to figure out what exactly her plan was but already knowing she can't escape, we decided to accept her proposal.

800390.Title: The Way of the Vessi
800390.Condition1: And Flemma actually did fight and came back with a blissful smile… Rapid Flame aren't in their right minds either.

800395.Title: The Traitor
800395.Condition1: Still not sure about Flemma, Senia's asked her to take down the leaders of Rapid Flame; Flemma took charge as if nothing had been said.

800400.Title: A Time for Change
800400.Condition1: Senia has seen straight through what Flemma wants. But it's not like the option of cutting the war off with Rapid Flame early is something to take lightly.

800405.Title: The One to Silence All
800405.Condition1: We've teamed up with Flemma to get rid of the remnants of Rapid Flame in Grace City.
800405.Condition2: Clear [City up in Flames] in [Hell City]

800410.Title: The Eye of the Typhoon
800410.Condition1: The remnants of Rapid Flame have been taken care of; Flemma's definitely gotten weaker but it was more than enough to take care of her own minions.

800415.Title: Their Own Laws
800415.Condition1: Most of Rapid Flame has now been taken care of; I guess we should be relieved that Grace City has found its peace once again.

800420.Title: An Undying Flame
800420.Condition1: And for the final battle, Flemma fought off the strongest leader still left in Grace City. If all goes well, hopefully this will be the end of dealing with Rapid Flame… but would it be that easy?

800425.Title: The Beginning of a Nightmare
800425.Condition1: The long battle with Rapid Flame is now over but now there's something else happening in Grace City…

101235.Title: The Beginning and the End
101235.Condition1:
Although the situation in Grace City made progress once, it wasn't enough to stop the enemy attacks.
In order to break through, we decided to seek answers from Tenebris who was still staying in Grasscover Camp...
101235.Condition2: Move to [Grasscover Camp] and speak to [Tenebris]

101240.Title: Road of Blossoming Flowers
101240.Condition1: SoulWorkers have split into two teams and headed to Rocco Town to investigate. While a team rescued Rogen, the other team investigated inside the Vacuum.

101245.Title: Disturbance in Rocco Town
101245.Condition1: Several abnormalities have been spotted in Rocco Town where more flowers blossomed than ever. Some people who have been stained with Soul Junk and Desire Energy. And they were heading in the direction of Grace City as if they had been ordered. Were they really following an order? Then, whose order is it?
101245.Condition2: Clear [Path of Fallen Salvation] in [Blooming Road]

101250.Title: The Era of The Vacuum
101250.Condition1:
We saw something that looked just like Lord...
It wasn't one or two standing in our way... A hundred, perhaps, a thousand of them appeared right before our eyes.
101250.Condition2: Clear [Flower Road of Desire] in [Blooming Road]

101255.Title: My Other Self
101255.Condition1: Upon receiving Toru's urgent call, we returned to face the other Jin Seipatsu. Materialized from Desire Energy that spread from Rocco Town to the entire world, he promised his full cooperation in capturing other Desire Workers that had been separated from SoulWorkers.
101255.Condition2: Speak to people in [Grace City] to figure out what's going on.

101260.Title: City Devoured by Desire
101260.Condition1:
Desire Personalities started to emerge as Desire Energy spread to the entire West Cloudream.
We decided to look for the Desire Personalities one by one and persuaded them to join us.

101265.Title: With All Our Hearts and Souls
101265.Condition1: One by one, and one child after another... Slowly but steadily, we gathered to join hands and finally got to laugh together again.

101270.Title: Children Growing Up
101270.Condition1:
We finally managed to save the Desire Energy of Stella and Lily and brought them to our side.
We wholeheartedly shared our own stories with each other.

101275.Title: At Enemies' End
101275.Condition1:
Next things we faced were Haru and Erwin's Desire Energy.
...Obviously, they are going to be the toughest opponents so far.
101275.Condition4: Speak to [Desire Haru] in [Nightmare of Vengeance and Pleasure]

101280.Title: Untold Stories
101280.Condition1:
Everyone has finished the conversations with their own Desire Personalities.
We will put all our past regrets and grudges behind and move on.

101285.Title: Facing the End
101285.Condition1:
The new mission began right after we finished talking to the Desire Personalities.
While we were preoccupied with our own affairs, the attack on District 6 grew more fierce and was now concentrated on the walls around Grace City. The city built giant outer walls to hold the enemies back, but it seemed clear that it wasn't going to last long without our help.
101285.Condition2: Speak to [Rauper] and [Rogen] while waiting for [Air Transport]

101290.Title: Hopeless Situation
101290.Condition1: The situation in the battlefield couldn't get any worse. Many of the Starry Forest League soldiers were injured while fending off countless enemies.

800435.Title: The Ordeal of Grace City
800435.Condition1: The Desire Energy spread from Rocco Town and began to cause countless strange phenomena all over the world. The Special Missions Unit was directly affected, too. I couldn't ignore its influence, either. I tried my best to pretend it's nothing, but know I won't last long like this.

800440.Title: Blushing Hell
800440.Condition1: I sent the kid to Rocco Town, who was not affected by the Desire Energy Crisis, hoping to confirm that this kid is completely free from Desire Energy. I know the First Generation of SoulWorkers has already cleared up that place, so there may be no threat after all.

800445.Title: Suspicion Toward the East
800445.Condition1:
I spoke with Rogen, the CEO of NED Company.
It seemed that he decided to participate in the war seeking redemption for what NED has done, without notifying the East.
If the East hadn't decided to turn a blind eye, this war would've been very different now.
800445.Condition2: Clear [Path of Fallen Salvation] in [Blooming Road]

800450.Title: My Own Karma
800450.Condition1:
My condition kept getting worse.
But I'm relieved that it hasn't affected that kid yet.
800450.Condition2: Clear [Flower Road of Desire] in [Blooming Road]

800455.Title: Personal Mission
800455.Condition1: While I was recovering on a hospital bed in Fortune Corps., it looked like that kid was trying to find a way to save the Special Missions Unit. It amazes me how that kid can act alone without being tied to the unit. I hope this becomes a trigger for that kid to be more independent for good...
800455.Condition2: Visit [Bernard] who's getting treated in Fortune Corps.

800460.Title: Civil Negotiation
800460.Condition1: After I regained consciousness, I found out about a deal with the Merchants' Union. Whether you're from the East or the West, they can be powerful allies if you know how to deal with them. I hope they could come to the aid for the kid in the future...
800460.Condition2: Take a Sample from the [Desire Illusionary Body] in [Day Dreamer]

800465.Title: Where is the Special Missions Unit?
800465.Condition1: However, that devious Merchants' Union had nothing but taking advantage of the kid's desperation in their minds. It looks like they lured that kid into joining a dangerous battle... Who can guarantee that something like this will never happen again later?
800465.Condition2: Take a Sample from the [Desire Illusionary Body] in [Day Dreamer]

800470.Title: The Curse of the East
800470.Condition1:
Miriam told me how much that kid tried so hard to save the Special Missions Unit.
Of course, I rushed to stop the kid...but I'm secretly glad that kid's moving forward in the right direction.
800470.Condition2: Defeat [Desire Illusionary Body] of [Haru Estia] in [Day Dreamer]

800475.Title: An Operator of the West
800475.Condition1:
I already made up my mind and returned to the East, leaving the kid here in the West. It took some while lies to calm that kid down... well... I probably won't be forgiven.
I met a new operator who's going to replace me. I'm sure the kid will be okay in the West now.
800475.Condition2: Stop the enemies attacking the [Great Grace Wall]

800490.Title: The Great Waves of Change I
800490.Condition1:
Although everyone will point fingers and call me a coward who fears change, those left in the West will change anyway. There will be resentment, but I will have to bear the consequences for what I have caused.
I’m going to stop adding entries to this journal anymore. I’m sure the kid that stays behind in the West will get along just fine with new companions. I don’t know what the future holds for that kid, but I sincerely hope that returning to the East is not an option.
Then good luck,

I give it my best... That is all for now.

We have obtained various cooperation there. It is not perfect yet, but we can have a small hope of victory.

101340.Title: How To Cut Off The Monster's Head
101340.Condition1: Following the instructions of Erwin Arclight, Spirit PathFinder, which had been unavailable, begins to be installed outside Cloudream. No one knows if the plan will go without any problems...

101345.Title: The First Strike
101345.Condition1: We have a plan. Find the location of Tenebris' real body and attack everyone together. However, the enemy is already close to Grace City, and there is not enough space to fight... Can we really win this fight in this desperate situation? Everyone has hope, but no one is sure.

The last battle of this war... Defeat is not an option.

101355.Title: Final Operation
101355.Condition1: Tenebris is finally defeated. All we have left is the disposal of enemy remnants. The Final Operation [Finale] is carried out to deal with enemies still running around Grace City.

101360.Title: Peace in the West... And...
101360.Condition1: Peace eventually returns to Cloudream. We went around every area of Rocco Town, Candus City, Ruin Fortress, and Grasscover Camp with our memories and ideals. And we talked to many people.

604420.Condition1: Grace City. One day upon returning from vacation. Toru and Erwin are talking to each other. It seems a story about a vacation that everyone went to.

604425.Title: Day 1: DAY
604425.Condition4: Speak to [Kane Barrel] in [Strange Holiday A]

604430.Title: Day 1: NIGHT (GHOST STORY)
604430.Condition1:
Beautiful sunny day on the beach. It's a perfect day to take a nap or hang out. 
For some reason, this vacation spot seems to be a place where strange rumors are in the air. Well... who cares? The first day fades into night. When the night comes... Fire up the grill for BBQ Party! Yay!

604435.Title: Day 2: DAY
604435.Condition1: A sudden power outage that occurred while listening to Betty's ghost story. According to Erwin, the suspect may be a child and a cat. Questions still remain. But today is beach volleyball day! Let's go to the beach right now!

604440.Title: Day 2: NIGHT (GHOST STORY)
604440.Condition1: An abandoned house discovered during an adventure in the mountains... What was that place for? Betty! She said she walked around this town and heard so many rumors. Maybe Betty is the one who can give me an answer.
604440.Condition4: Speak to [Kane Barrel] in [Strange Holiday N]

604445.Title: Day 3: DAY
604445.Condition1: It is said that there was a person who told Betty a malicious rumor. How come? The abandoned house was explored personally, but the truth of the ghost stories was still unknown. By the way, why is everyone still sleeping?

604450.Title: Day 3: NIGHT (GHOST STORY)
604450.Condition1: Betty has vanished without a trace. I thought she was in town or somewhere else hanging out. But... time has passed, and I still haven't heard anything from Betty yet.

604455.Title: Last Day: Questions
604455.Condition1:
When Erwin said Betty would be fine, everyone decided to sleep. Just for now…
Will Betty be back when I wake up? Someone, please tell me what the hell is going on here.

604460.Title: Last Day: Answers
604460.Condition1: Betty is back! With a surprising unexpected guest! The guest is a cat, and it is turning into Soul Junk. Of course, cat owners seem to want to explain something. But, I need to fill up my stomach first and then listen to their stories.

604465.Title: Holiday Memories: The End
604465.Condition1:
The secret of the island was revealed, and Toru apologized. Sedurin doesn't seem to want it very much, but she said she'd research about it. Well.. that's it. SoulWorkers' vacation ends like this.
Wait, wait a second. Looks like Erwin has something to say little bit more. Let's sneak in and hear what he says.

101380.Title: Calm Before the Storm
101380.Condition1: Bad news has been heard from those who went on a patrol. Damn... I knew it. Half year is not enough time to organize the peace. A storm is coming eventually, and there is nothing that can be done but confronts it. The night is dark and calm, but the coming turmoil will not. Trials that may be endless are approaching. So, it's time to prepare for impact.
101380.Condition2: Prepare for an encounter with [Vacuum Fanatics]

101385.Title: Life and Dignity
101385.Condition1: Humans fight each other even if the devil is standing ahead. What is right is not always popular and what is popular is not always right. Unfortunately, it is too difficult to realize that it is wrong. Then, what is the price? Obviously, innocent people and the world. The only solution is to eliminate the cause quickly. Can humans do that? The entire civilization has been suffering from the Vacuum for too long... Nothing is sure this time.

101390.Title: Soldiers of Humanity
101390.Condition1: Traitors inside Lords. But their betrayal is a hope for us. They became traitors to confront people with false beliefs. Now, we have to hide in the enemy's heart with them.Although... it is still difficult to fully believe those insiders.

101395.Title: Operation: Trench Run
101395.Condition1: Operation [Trench Run] has begun to discuss. The Operation has to be perfect, and no source of anxiety allows. Vista... must be hunted down. With the cooperation of the Navy and the Air Force, the success of [Trench Run] is critical to changing the advantages of East Lords Army's genetically modified human experiment into Disadvantages. Otherwise, there will be disastrous wars.
101395.Condition2: Participate in the Military Operation Meeting in [Grace City]

101400.Title: For Liberation
101400.Condition1: We have arrived in the city of Air Force [Arcadia Realm], the center of all future operations and liberation. The city of abundance and safety. It was built on the materialism of the rich in the pre-Vacuum era and the suffering of the poor who are still being overworked down there. But this time we should enjoy those things anyway.

101405.Title: Warmingflower Farm
101405.Condition1: Warmingflower Farm. Once, this place was the eastern stronghold of the Cherry Blossom Vessi. Some of Bad Kids, who were kicked out by Good Kids and Starry Forest League, still live this abandoned farm. Vacuum Junks are roaming around, and there is also a chance to encounter Bad Kids.
101405.Condition2: Enter [Warmingflower Farm] in [The State of Flower Garden]

101410.Title: The Ally from the North
101410.Condition1: Soon, we will meet Good Kid who is friendly to humans, and [Thomas], the Commander of the North Starry Forest League, who is in charge of the State of Flower Garden with Good Kid. And here is a question. Could there be love between a Human and a Vessi? [Thomas] and [Lyla] answer that question with action without hesitation.
101410.Condition2: Team up with [Occupation Troops] at [Warmingflower Farm]
101410.Condition4: Speak to [Thomas] in [Warmingflower Farm: Ideological Conflicts]

101415.Title: A Man with Foxtail Grass in His Mouth
101415.Condition1: Thomas and Lyla are deeply in love with each other. Human and Vessi in love? SoulWorkers can hardly understand them, but try to admit it to a certain extent.  We realize that Good Kid of North Cherry Blossom Vessi has a cooperative attitude, and Human-Vessi cooperation is also working very well here.
101415.Condition4: Speak to [Thomas] in [Warmingflower Farm: Delusion about Cherry Blossom]

101420.Title: Fairy and Human
101420.Condition1: We hear stories about an incident in the past that triggered a relationship between Thomas and Lyla. However, it is still hard to believe that humans and the Vessi can be culturally harmonized. So, Thomas and Lyla? To SoulWorkers, they are just one hell of a strange couple.
101420.Condition2: Listen to stories of [Thomas] and [Lyla] at [Warmingflower Farm]

101425.Title: Starlight Garden
101425.Condition1: A Garden Full of Flowers from Another World. A place is full of plants from Another World that no one can ever guess. Bad Kid and Good Kid are fighting to the death for the Honey from 'Moonlight Flower'; their staple food for a living. Taking this strategic location means they can effectively keep opponents in check. So, it's time to move for Good Kid.
101425.Condition2: Enter [Warmingflower Farm] in [The State of Flower Garden]
101425.Condition4: Speak to [Rona] in [Starlight Garden: Moonlight Flowers]

101430.Title: Inside Stories of Cherry Blossom
101430.Condition1: The prejudice and anxiety of SoulWorkers against Good Kid, the Cherry Blossom Vessi, have been somewhat resolved. Lyla provides SoulWorkers with useful information about Cherry Blossom, and she is supporting Thomas with all her heart.
101430.Condition2: Get information about [Cherry Blossom Vessi] at [Starlight Garden]

101435.Title: Bad Kids I
101435.Condition1: SoulWorkers decides to move in two teams. Alpha Team will eliminate Bad Kids and Vacuum Junks to take over [Guardian] brought by the Good Kid Vessi. Awfully hideous looking? It does not matter. [Big Dumb Bully] the Super Powerful Guardian will be a great help here.
101435.Condition2: Things to be done before the arrival of [Guardian]
101435.Condition4: Speak to [Thomas] in [Starlight Garden: Defeat in Detail]

101440.Title: Bad Kids II
101440.Condition1: Bravo Team is ready to attack [Elder Kid], the leader of Bad Kid, to break down the command system. Then, Bad Kid will be embarrassed by the fact that Elder Kid was taken. Get Ready. It's time to seize and make her talk.
101440.Condition2: Defeat [Elder Kid] who is the Leader of [Bad Kid]

101445.Title: The White Giant
101445.Condition1: The Guardian has arrived and joined the party of SoulWorkers. Great help for all of us according to Good Kid... yes, this white-skinned big ugly monster seemed like a perfect ally... Until a monster lost its mind at the signal from Elder Kid. Lyla was hit and fainted, and the monster ran away from the scene. Furious Thomas has begun to chase it to kill.
101445.Condition2: Calm [Guardian] down and start the chase
101445.Condition4: Speak to [Thomas] in [Starlight Garden: Weird Looking Ally]

101450.Title: Blood Vengeance
101450.Condition1: Thomas insists that the monster must be captured alive for revenge. East Starry Forest Air Force and West SoulWorkers agree with Thomas... for now... However, the capture operation, which proceeds without knowing where the monster has fled, will exhaust everyone.

101455.Title: Giant Fear
101455.Condition1: Eventually, [Giant One], once called the guardian, ran away from Starlight Garden and headed to the rugged mountain. Daphnyre, Admiral of the Navy, gives Heitz the disturbing news. And SoulWorkers are forced to start searching the mountain to capture the monster.
101455.Condition4: Speak to [Heitz] in [Giant Fear: Climbing Mountains]

101460.Title: The Revenger's Oath
101460.Condition1: Thomas finally finds a compromise with the Air Force and SoulWorkers. Even if the monster is on the verge of death, it will be no problem. The compromise is that he only wants to kill that monster with his own hands. Thomas seems to think that is the right way to love Lyla. The Air Force and SoulWorkers decide to compromise to that extent. The search for a white-skinned monster in the mountain begins again.
101460.Condition2: Persuade [Thomas] to conduct a safer military operation
101460.Condition4: Speak to [Heitz] in [Giant Fear: The Basis of Love]

101465.Title: Bad choice out of Anger
101465.Condition1: Thomas, who fails to control his anger, eventually continues his search too deep and is trapped by Bad Kid and isolated. SoulWorkers are dispatched for urgent assistance. He relents his rage once again, regretting his mistake.
101465.Condition2: Rescue [Thomas] from the trap of [Bad Kid]

101470.Title: Giant Hunt I
101470.Condition1: SoulWorkers decides to move in two teams again. Based on the fact that [Giant One] reacts particularly to Major Thomas, he decides to lure the monster by using himself as bait. Alpha Team defends the approach of Giant One while standing on the road, and Bravo team forms a siege together to carry out a joint attack when the monster breaks through Alpha Team.
101470.Condition2: [Thomas] lures [Giant One] by using himself as bait

101475.Title: Giant Hunt II
101475.Condition1: Thomas grabs his weapon. Yes, he is ready to kill [Giant One]. The plan is also underway to end this fight in a flash by driving the monster to a place where it cannot escape along the cliff. Nothing but the final showdown is left now.
101475.Condition4: Speak to [Heitz] in [Giant Fear: Before The Showdown]

101480.Title: Devil's Grasp
101480.Condition1: The showdown left nothing but terrible scars. Thomas broke down... He never knew that his hatred would return as his sorrows. The trigger of the gun was already pulled and its precious soul was gone. The will turned into an indelible scar on Thomas. And, Lyla... she came here too late.
101480.Condition2: Check the True Identity of [Giant One]

101485.Title: The worst is yet to come
101485.Condition1: A mad scientist may be born if a scientist has not mastered proper humanistic knowledge. Just like Vista. She came to Arcadia Realm and revealed to Thomas that she was the mastermind starting all this. Also, a murder is announced by Vista that Lyla may be the next target.
101485.Condition2: [Vista] tells [Thomas] about Another Tragedy to come

101490.Title: Whisper of the Beast I
101490.Condition1: We have to check what Vista said to Thomas and then predict how Vista will approach Lyla. At the same time, we must make sure the Good Kid Vessi is still safe... There should be no more tragic incidents. SoulWorkers went into action immediately. Cause there was no time to hesitate.
101490.Condition2: Gathering Information to Prevent [Vista] from Outrageous Crime

101495.Title: Whisper of the Beast II
101495.Condition1: [Dead Mother of Thomas]... [a Mad Scientist who said she could revive her]... [Lyla would believe that Scientist without any doubt]... she loves Thomas so much with all her heart and soul. The Inside of the Syringe found was Empty. Everyone has a bad feeling about this... maybe it's already Too Late...
101495.Condition2: Ask [Sedurin] for advice on the Biotech of [Vista]

101500.Title: Whisper of the Beast III
101500.Condition1: Sedurin was not a biotech scientist, and it was not a good place to hire many researchers to conduct that kind of research activities here. So, the sample was sent to the West. The research were conducted by Sarah. The result came out sooner than we expected. According to Sarah, if a sample from Vista's syringe was injected into the Giant One, the biological catastrophe that would occur was beyond measure.
101500.Condition2: Receive a Warning from [Sarah] about the Biotech of [Vista]

101505.Title: Whisper of the Beast IV
101505.Condition1: All the things that we were worried about actually happened. Vista approached Lyla with diabolical plans, and she was completely deceived by Vista's sweet talk. ...His mother was dead. Now, Lyla is gone. Thomas has lost the light of his life again and again. A man who has lost everything... What can he possibly do? Thomas decides to kill... Vista. There will be Revenge that no one can stop this time...

510.Condition1: A Girl who Sings to the Stars

3060.Title: A Story No One will Remember
3060.Condition1: A Story No One will Remember

810005.Title: Wake Me Up
810005.Condition1:
I have no idea how long it's been since that day...
But, I am here. Still alive.
Thanks to......... someone...

2810005.Title: Things Unforseen
2810005.Condition1:
I heard about the children... involved in the accident... because... because of me...
But, but I... I didn’t know what I should do...

810010.Title: Supernatural?
810010.Condition1:
And then, I’ve got this... power.
You know I've lost a lot in my life. Yes, this power... I am sure I was asked to protect and never ever give up.

810015.Title: People from the West
810015.Condition1: I was surprised there were people from the West came to help us. Why am I surprised? Well... Because they appeared... all of a sudden...
810015.Condition2: Speak to [Merchants' Union] in [Tower of Lord]

810020.Title: Sense of Shame
810020.Condition1:
Before I closed my eyes... 
The helplessness that I felt countless times came faster than I thought.

810025.Title: A Bad Kid
810025.Condition1: I was in a hurry to save people at the time. In the end, I didn't hear her voice, which always watched and cared for me... (I should've listened to her...)

810030.Title: Penumbra
810030.Condition1: I asked other people for advice and decided what I should do...

810035.Title: Losers
810035.Condition1: Is Starry Forest League... the Right Place?

810040.Title: The Vacuum that Connected
810040.Condition1:
My Sis said when something came out of the Vacuum, it seemed like it was being spat out. But she told me they looked like they walked out on their own.
Hmm... what is the difference...? Well, it’s a little hard for me to understand now.

810045.Title: Accompany
810045.Condition1:
... Sis.
I was so worried and scared... Did you always wait for me like this?
810045.Condition2: Clear [Vile Stench of the Battleground] in [Broken Way]
810045.Condition4: Speak to [Reive] in [Vile Stench of the Battleground]

810050.Title: Gamble
810050.Condition1:
In the face of undeniable facts... I couldn't say anything.
But you Sis... told me that I don't have to deny it.
I... I...

810055.Title: To the Muddled World
810055.Condition1: I thought I wouldn't be denied if I stuck together with my Sis.

810060.Title: The Vacuum that Created
810060.Condition1:
They... I mean people from the West, they were all good people.
B-But... They seemed to be afraid of Something.

810065.Title: Perforated Road
810065.Condition1:
Again, I... I didn't think of anything else... Sorry...
I just... um... I thought I had to save all of them.

810070.Title: People Chasing Stars
810070.Condition1:
I met someone who had similar concerns as me...
She knew my Sis... well... I think I can get along with her in many ways.
810070.Condition2: Install [Modified Amplifier] in [Glowing Streets] of [Perforated Street]

810075.Title: Desire
810075.Condition1:
Tenebris said Soul Energy eventually started with Desire Energy.
If so... What on earth was I...?

810080.Title: Someone to Believe and Follow
810080.Condition1:
I'm not ready to lead someone in front or push someone from behind yet... No.. I am Not ready...
But, there's Someone I want to keep looking at... all the time...

810085.Title: It can’t happen here
810085.Condition1: A place is messing with people's minds... That's So Gross!

810090.Title: Trauma
810090.Condition1: Oh no... I can't believe how this place can use people's deepest parts of sadness in this way...

810095.Title: Guilty Conscience
810095.Condition1:
.... No...
Everything is My Fault... I'm the one who should disappear... instead of them...
810095.Condition2: Clear [Mould in the Darkness] in [Dreadful Echo]

810100.Title: Remember
810100.Condition1:
Please tell me... did I do something wrong again?
Am I worthy of consolation?
Why... are you... ... Just... just punish me...

810105.Title: I am with you
810105.Condition1:
Everyone has stars, but they are not the same things for different people. Now I can see they are getting ready to walk forward again.
...And ME TOO!

810110.Title: Eaten by the Vacuum
810110.Condition1: I think... I see some people took the wrong path...

810115.Title: How to Wake THEM Up
810115.Condition1:
I couldn't save enough people... (So depressed...) But, No Time to Regret! I will save as many people as possible from now on!
I'll show you the empathy I learned from a book! Don't have a heart attack.
810115.Condition2: Rescue [Soldier] from [Bloody Harvest] of [Man Eater Garden]

810120.Title: Broken Justice
810120.Condition1:
Tenebris... I heard about him while tracking the survivors.
Also, I heard about the Tragedy of the Night Sky... Now I am wondering... if SFL is the right place for me.

810125.Title: Pincer Movement
810125.Condition1:
I'm working with the Hero of the West! Kane Barrel! You know him, right?
I don't know much about his fighting style... But I do want to learn the way he cares about people.

810130.Title: Regret
810130.Condition1:
I heard the Vacuum is not a natural disaster... but Someone made it up.
Why.. why did he create such a terrible thing? This is insane...  I swear I'll never forgive him!

810135.Title: Revenger
810135.Condition1:
I went to rescue the missing soldiers and met a Sister with somehow empty eyes at the entrance to the factory.
... I wonder what happened to her.
810135.Condition2: Clear [Dead Meat Breeding Ground] in [Dead Meat Factory]

810140.Title: Getting Lost
810140.Condition1: And what I saw when I went deeper... there was Someone who wanted to die. Something was willing to kill that someone, and there was Another Person who looked sadly at all of them.
810140.Condition2: Clear [Greed and Decline] in [Dead Meat Factory]

810145.Title: Finding the Fun
810145.Condition1:
It's like a child's imagination to find only pleasant things.
And... No one is allowed to mock a dying man's last request like that.

810150.Title: Liar's World
810150.Condition1: ... No, I don’t buy it, you liar.

810155.Title: Trust
810155.Condition1:
... Yeah.
Even if everything else is false...
I'll believe what gave me faith... unless... unless my heart is a lie.

810160.Title: No Trail Left Behind
810160.Condition1: After finishing some work on the Grasscover Camp, I took steps to find people who needed my help.

810165.Title: Tragic City
810165.Condition1:
I arrived in a port city in the West to accomplish this Crazy Operation as soon as possible.
Honestly, I didn't want to come to the city when I heard many people were killed in a reckless operation... But if I don't come here, there will be more sacrifices for sure.

810170.Title: Another Revenger
810170.Condition1:
There was someone... I didn't want to get close to as soon as I met him. But he had a similar vibe to someone I had seen before...
I... um... I just... felt like I couldn't leave him alone.

810175.Title: Military Base Protection
810175.Condition1:
Do you know what I thought while maintaining the defense line of the base along sky road? I thought it was a waste that a place with such beautiful scenery was destroyed.
If I try really hard... I can restore this place to the good old days, right?

810180.Title: Discard
810180.Condition1:
My Sister is making a very scary face at Beneris, who supervises the scene on behalf of Aaron.
I wonder what's going on between them...
810180.Condition2: Install [Vacuum Vein Suppression Device] in [Great Air Defense] of [Sky Walker]

810185.Title: Prove
810185.Condition1:
At the news that a gigantic Soul Junk was coming this way, I just went out to fight that thing to protect everyone...
W-Wait. OH MY GOODNESS... How am I supposed to kill something This Big...?

810190.Title: Dark Intentions
810190.Condition1:
No matter how good the technology is, it means nothing if it's not used properly. I do understand my Sis doesn't want to share her knowledge with Victor.
Well... I will focus on what I should do. Let me clean up those Soul Junks now!

810195.Title: Cheap Trick
810195.Condition1:
Soul Junks on the sea, their movement was very strange. They didn’t attack me recklessly... and seemed to be waiting for something.
It was so weird... Because I heard Soul Junks couldn't have that level of intelligence.

810200.Title: Wrong Intervention
810200.Condition1:
The Soul Junk that appeared last time was a really big one, and Something Similar in Size is approaching now. And this time, my Sis said she would go into military operation herself.
Can I... she... Can we make it...?

810205.Title: Deep Grudge
810205.Condition1:
He said... the opposite of [Bad] didn't just mean [Good], and it did not matter as long as it was not related to [Bad] or [Worst].
I am still not sure... but I may thought what he said seemed right...

810210.Title: Contact
810210.Condition1:
The story my Sis told me... it was very shocking...
What I went through was because of my sister's other younger sister...

810215.Title: Beasts
810215.Condition1:
I wish I had known in advance.... it was HER who Victor was following...
I'm regretting it right now...

810220.Title: Evil Destiny
810220.Condition1:
Uh... Wow... my Sis... QuadStella TriSilva...?!
I don't know why she hasn't told me this so far...

810225.Title: Too Much Confidence
810225.Condition1:
When Arua heard the Nihill Kingdom was marching here, She looked So Happy and went to the battlefield before anyone else...
But... I felt like something unfortunate was going to happen to her...

810230.Title: Method
810230.Condition1:
I had no idea how to react to Arua when she gave me detailed information about the Nihill Kingdom's tactics...
Well... it doesn't seem right... but it's okay, right...?

810235.Title: Human and Vessi
810235.Condition1:
Nihill Kingdom is advancing here with all its troops gathered... What? because of Me...?!
I just want to solve it through conversation... I mean peaceful conversation...

810240.Title: Tarnished Honor
810240.Condition1:
I wanted to somehow persuade Arua's Knight Commander to stop this pointless fight.
And now we know each other's true feelings, everything will be fine... (I guess...)

810245.Title: The Event Horizon
810245.Condition1:
A tragic thing happened when I hesitated... And it made me very depressed. But Arua was different. She assumed an attitude of determination despite her sadness.
Anyway... I just don’t think I can face my sister...

810250.Title: The Rise of Fake History
810250.Condition1: I don't know what's going to happen down here...

810255.Title: The Devil was Here in This Lab
810255.Condition1:
We've found a lot of data related to Soul Junk experiments in the NED Company Laboratory.
And somehow... my Sis said the data felt similar to her research...

810260.Title: Moonlight without Lights
810260.Condition1:
That Soul Junk at the bottom of the sinkhole! I mean the Queen! ... was really Royal Highness... Lunar Nox.
I was so unhappy that there was no way to get her back to being Vessi again. And... Suddenly, I heard something fall with a thump! Hmm... maybe. Maybe not...
810260.Condition2: Clear [Physique Upgrade Diagnostic Room] in [S303 Shelter]

810265.Title: Déjà vu
810265.Condition1:
We have found so much significant data... Such as the reason NED Company was able to continue their research in this place and why things shouldn't exist have been here.
But I think... the most important thing for me right now is...
810265.Condition2: Clear [Danger Object Isolation Room] in [S303 Shelter]

810270.Title: The Miraculous Shadow
810270.Condition1:
I don't know if it's okay to send them like that...
But I decided to go down again... You know I can't just let the Threat down there.

810275.Title: Hope, Expectations, and the Lottery
810275.Condition1:
When I met him again, he was struggling in pain...
But he was holding out with only one commitment... Finding Royal Highness... wherever she was.
810275.Condition2: Clear [Road to Eternal Life] in [Unholy Sanatarium]

810280.Title: Damaged Justice
810280.Condition1:
I always thought there was something dark behind this situation. And you know what? I finally found Him!
If I stop him, well... maybe I can end this matter here.
By the way, I feel like... I know that person standing next to him... Hmm...

810285.Title: Unexpected Results
810285.Condition1:
I took another shortcut to get to the end of the cathedral. That was the only way to avoid Neb.
...And there... I had to accept two things that were still hard to believe and understand...

810290.Title: People Hiding Something
810290.Condition1: This place is no different. People have something not telling me... I can tell...

810295.Title: We Stay Here
810295.Condition1: They said they would withdraw from here. It's okay, cause it's time to move on to solve the one thing that bothered us here!
810295.Condition2: Clear [Base of Cults] in [Dawn of Fate]

810300.Title: Too Late to Go Back
810300.Condition1:
Looks like... Tenebris has seen and experienced many things... a lot of things... And he is very much disappointed in the end.
If someone had told him not to go at the time... Wouldn't we be facing a different Tenebris now?
810300.Condition2: Clear [Downfall of Hero] in [Dawn of Fate]

810310.Title: Death or Paradise?
810310.Condition1:
Why? Why didn't You stop? All your senses were telling you to Run Away!
You Idiot~!! I never wanted to be here inside! Do You know why I’m here now? Because of YOU!! (F**K!!)
810310.Condition2: Clear [Dawn of Destiny] in [Dawn of Fate]

810315.Title: Now and Forever
810315.Condition1:
For the first time in my life...
...I think I got what I wanted.
810315.Condition2: Remove [Crack] from All Over the Place

810320.Title: Fading Grace
810320.Condition1:
The West was in even greater danger when we couldn't move at the time.
Rapid Flame's attack was getting stronger day by day, and Unknown Energy was gathering in District 6... well, I can't give up!

810325.Title: Fanatics in White Nights
810325.Condition1:
I heard the Vacuum Fanatics that I saw at the Dipluce also appeared here.
But it seems... something different from the fanatics back then. Hmm... where the hell are they from?

810330.Title: Dead or Alive
810330.Condition1:
Through an autopsy of the Fanatics Bishop, we could find their gathering place using the energy wavelengths they used for communication.
I think I can figure out why Fanatics are doing this if I can catch a commander.

810335.Title: The World Rises Again
810335.Condition1:
I felt like I was going down more than I heard from Near SoulWorkers...
What's in here? What is hidden down here?

810340.Title: People We've Lost
810340.Condition1:
The hacked Ruin Fortress facilities were all returned to normal by my sister...
But I heard some machines were still out of control. So I went back down there to destroy all of them.

810345.Title: Treason
810345.Condition1:
I had to confront a person who did this.
He looked very angry and upset... But why does he remind me of my sister's words? (Whining child's silly complaint...)
810345.Condition2: Clear [The End of Failure] in [Project Resurrection]

810350.Title: Into the Different World
810350.Condition1:
That Near SoulWorker we saved so hard suddenly left the city. And unlike usual, my Sis looks anxious...
But... we don't have time to care about that right now.

810355.Title: Sudden Attack
810355.Condition1:
Finally, a total war against the Rapid Flame has begun...
They made a surprise attack on our back and confused us.
And that... sadly very effective to me...

810360.Title: Counter Attack
810360.Condition1:
I needed to bring them together for a successful operation. So, I decided to push myself to the limit.
Using my abilities to lure them... is the best way for now.
810360.Condition2: Clear [Bloody Fight in the Passage] in [Untouchable Pass]

810365.Title: Torch
810365.Condition1:
We found the captain of the shock troops and immediately began to pursue him.
He seemed to be running away. But it was very strange... He was running away in the opposite direction of where his troops had penetrated.

810370.Title: City in Flames
810370.Condition1: ... No way... This can’t be real...
810370.Condition2: Clear [City turned into Hell] in [Hell City]

810375.Title: What Should I Do?
810375.Condition1:
Rapid Flame... this time they've gone too far. You know I could kill them all...
Thanks to Toru's words, I finally came to my senses. And then I started doing things that could save people.

810380.Title: Tactical Deception
810380.Condition1:
Senia told me that Rapid Flame could attack other cities while I was focusing on Flemma. After I heard that, I thought of a trick and suggested it to her.
Then...

810385.Title: I will Run to You
810385.Condition1:
I decided to drag on as long as I could... Then, I took one step ahead for people to evacuate safely.
Of course... there is also my Personal Grudge against Him.

810390.Title: Empty Promise
810390.Condition1: Always with me? Forever?... well.. maybe I'll be left alone in the end... maybe I just don't want to be sad anymore...

810395.Title: The End Begins
810395.Condition1: There was no time to be relieved the Rapid Flame had withdrawn because the news came that the Vacuum on the Rocco Town side was suddenly bigger. It's time to move for an investigation.

810400.Title: I see ghosts (Lucky me?!)
810400.Condition1:
As the Vacuum grew, news of seeing Tenebris phantoms came from here and there.
At first, I wondered what was going on...
810400.Condition2: Clear [Path of Fallen Salvation] in [Blooming Road]

810405.Title: A Nightmare Come True
810405.Condition1:
I heard she has never seen people in the Vacuum driven by Desire walk out on their own into the outside world.
Then it would be either. The properties of the Vacuum have changed, or...
810405.Condition2: Clear [Flower Road of Desire] in [Blooming Road]

810410.Title: Another Me
810410.Condition1:
A Desire Worker suddenly appeared in front of us! It caused everyone to make a fuss for a while. But, people were quickly relieved because his behavior was very favorable.
But... I-I...

810415.Title: Entirely Unpredictable
810415.Condition1: OMG... Near SoulWorkers... They seem to be free spirits all the time. Are they always like that?
810415.Condition2: Clear [Lucid Dream of Treason and Passion] in [Day Dreamer]

810420.Title: My Grudge Your Rage
810420.Condition1:
A person I saw in the Vacuum... I think she was a friend of Sedurin...
And the person we're going to meet is...
810420.Condition2: Clear [Delusion of Wrath and Gluttony] in [Day Dreamer]

810425.Title: Lost Children
810425.Condition1:
She... I've met Her before in the Vacuum. She kept saying she wanted to die... And today, I met Her again.
... ...I don't know if I can understand her deepest emotions...
810425.Condition2: Clear [Daydream of Lunacy and Sorrow] in [Day Dreamer]

810430.Title: The Day We Meet Again
810430.Condition1:
She kept telling me to go away without paying attention...
No... I can NEVER leave her alone!
810430.Condition2: Clear [Nightmare of Vengeance and Pleasure] in [Day Dreamer]
810430.Condition4: Speak to [Desire Haru] in [Nightmare of Vengeance and Pleasure]

810435.Title: The Story Continues...
810435.Condition1: I-I... More people believed in and supported me than I thought...

810440.Title: The Uncertainty of War
810440.Condition1: Defensive walls surrounding the city have risen. But the Threat of Desire still hasn't gone away.

810445.Title: The Queen of Nihill Kingdom
810445.Condition1: Uh... Haven't we met before? You look really... Really Familiar...

810450.Title: Broken Memory
810450.Condition1:
We thought we'd managed to find a way out with the help of the Nihill Kingdom and Desire Workers...
But He appeared before us, denying Him...
810450.Condition2: Clear [Where The Last Justice Lies] in [Emergency Call]
810450.Condition4: Speak to [Neb] in [Where the Last Justice Lies]

810455.Title: The Last Alliance
810455.Condition1: Toru said the time has come to an end this war. And he asked me to go here and there to get help from many people.

810460.Title: Fragments of Another History
810460.Condition1:
We're here. And we're ready.
But... something bad always happen at times like this...
810460.Condition2: Clear [Final War in the West] in [Doom of West]

810465.Title: Mere Toys for God
810465.Condition1:
God thinks of our efforts as just play or nothing? ...Nonsense!
It's time to let him know that he's made a really big mistake. And we will rise and show the iron will of man!
810465.Condition2: Clear [Stroll of God] in [Doom of West]

810470.Title: Promise & Goodbye
810470.Condition1:
I shouldn't believe that promise... But... but I trusted... her. Because! She is my... everyth... Do I need a reason to believe someone I trust?
At that time, I...

810475.Title: One Step Forward
810475.Condition1:
I-I have to hang in there against Tenebris one way or another... so that everything can start...
Am I confident? No, but it was such a weight off my mind when I thought it was something I had to do anyway!

810480.Title: Dreamland Permanently Closed
810480.Condition1: This is it... the end of the story... I mean about Me... that I didn't want to talk about anymore.

810485.Title: Path of Revenge
810485.Condition1:
Six months have already passed since then... I've lived like a [Shadow] of Heitz.
Oh! Of course, I still live like that.

810490.Title: The Bad Kid's Farm
