101510.Title: Mad Scientist
101510.Condition1: Heitz and Martin have finally found the location where Vista is believed to be located. No time to hesitate. They immediately called SoulWorkers. Once known as Paradise Island, Haven Island was rich in trade with Arcadia Realm. But now there is no light and no human footprint. And Heitz told SoulWorkers it's time to begin a manhunt for Vista... right here.

101515.Title: Deadly Quiet Heaven
101515.Condition1: SoulWorkers have finally arrived in Haven Island. A... paradise? The island is completely in ruins. All of a sudden, the Vacuum Junk appears and attacks SoulWorkers. Something... Something's not right... They realize that bodies are Heavier than usual.

101520.Title: Real or Hallucination?
101520.Condition1: SoulWorkers try hard to move forward by knocking down the Vacuum Junk. And then, a huge structure begins to be seen before them. SoulWorkers believe that the gigantic building must be Vista's Laboratory. No fear. No hesitation. No doubt... They start heading to the Lab... of a Mad Scientist.

101525.Title: Medically Unknown Symptoms
101525.Condition1: Heitz constantly coughs on her way to the lab. Eventually, she can't stand the pain and falls down. SoulWorkers decide to leave Haven Island immediately and return to Arcadia Realm... to save her. After arriving, they visit Sedurin to ask why Heitz is sick.

101530.Title: Search for the Signal
101530.Condition1: Sedurin has asked SoulWorkers to go back to Haven Island with her Signal Detector. They hope this device finds out a certain signal that made Heitz sick and fall.

101535.Title: No Longer Human
101535.Condition1: At last, SoulWorkers have found a device that emits certain signals, and it looks obvious this machine is the one that transforms people into Vacuum Junk. There's no need to think or hesitate. The device is completely crushed by SoulWorkers. No more Vacuum Junk. Bodies are not heavy anymore. One of the missions accomplished? At that precise moment, a big wolf appeared in front of SoulWorkers.

101540.Title: Chasing the Wolf
101540.Condition1: SoulWorkers went after the ambushed wolf, and the place where the wolf arrived was the Entrance to the Laboratory. A coincidence? It's exactly where they aimed as a mission. At that moment, SoulWorkers encountered a wol... No! Three Wolves in front of the laboratory entrance.

101545.Title: Fox Must Die
101545.Condition1: Heitz was restored to health without any further problems. And SoulWorkers killed all the enemies at the laboratory entrance. Now's the time for them to enter the lab of Vista. Heitz also called Thomas to the front of the laboratory, and she told him to go into the lab with the SoulWorkers...

101550.Title: Unexpected Cooperator
101550.Condition1: No one had a map of the lab. But this place was too big and wide. SoulWorkers and Thomas were afraid they'd miss Vista here... They were at a loss for how to find their destination. Just then, a mysterious girl appeared in front of them. The girl told them where to go to meet Vista. And... she suddenly disappeared in a flash.

101555.Title: Up Again
101555.Condition1: SoulWorkers and Thomas moved in the direction that the mysterious girl told them. However, the Lab was bigger than expected, and even the destination was not visible at all. In the end, Thomas couldn't control his anger. (Was it a mistake to believe that girl?) They calmed Thomas down for now. And they decided to find out who the mysterious girl really was.
101555.Condition2: Investigate [Chamber Astray: Where Guinea Pigs are Locked Up]
101555.Condition4: Speak to [Thomas] in [Where Guinea Pigs are Locked Up]

101560.Title: Obsession and Revenge
101560.Condition1: SoulWorkers and Thomas encountered Relfenne, who was taken away by Victor. She rushed at them, shouting the name of the man she loved... Relfenne was much stronger than before and used a strange force unlike in the past.

101565.Title: Hide and Seek
101565.Condition1: Relfenne eventually ran away. And SoulWorkers and Thomas arrived in front of a lab. UNEXPECTED ENCOUNTER... There was VISTA!!! SoulWorkers ran to kill Vista, but she completely ignored them and walked away. No time to waste, but Vista's creations swarmed to kill SoulWorkers. Kill them all and Find Her... (before it is too late.)

101570.Title: Pain of Nostalgia in a Familiar Place
101570.Condition1: SoulWorkers and Thomas chased Vista in the direction of her disappearance and arrived at a huge lab. No sign of Vista... there was only one experimental capsule containing the upper body of a giant woman. And they encountered the mysterious girl there again. She warned them not to look for her but to find Vista. Stella's Grampy came out and explained about the giant woman after that mysterious girl flew away.

101575.Title: Deep Down

101575.Condition2: Investigate [Tainted Aspiration: To the Top of the Lab]

101585.Title: Guilty or Not Guilty
101585.Condition1: SoulWorkers and Thomas found Victor deep inside the laboratory. He was barely breathing because of a major injury. SoulWorkers were gained a map to get to Vista... And Victor, he just fainted. After leaving Victor to Force Strike Soldiers, SoulWorkers and Thomas headed back to the top of the lab.

101590.Title: My Opinion of Your Opinion
101590.Condition1: SoulWorkers said Victor may have helped Vista’s experiment. Then, Thomas got mad and said Victor should be detained and questioned. It was a mess; Victor still needed wound care. Thomas was trying to interrogate him. And SoulWorkers stopped Thomas. First things first, SoulWorkers and Thomas headed to the top of the lab. But there was bad blood between them...

And then he started attacking SoulWorkers with Soul Junk all over his body.
